fields.title: Ku Mulyango Omufunda
fields.subtitle: Emboozi ey’Omukwano n’Abanoonya
fields.description: Charles Spurgeon yawandiika akatabo kano ku lw’abo abalwalwanira ebweru w’omulyango gw’obulokozi—abazuukusiddwa, abeeraliikirivu, abaali kumpi okukkirizibwa, naye nga tebannakkiriza. N’ebbugumu n’obunkenke bye ebimanyiddwa, aggyawo ebizibu ebiziyiza abanoonya okujja eri Kristo, ng’alaga okukkiriza bwe kuli okwangu ddala n’ensonga lwaki tewali kirala kitali kyo ekimala. Gwe mukono ogw’omukwano ogugololwa eri buli musomi ali kumpi n’obwakabaka naye nga tannabuyingira.
fields.hook: Okumpi n’okukkiriza, naye nga tonnaba? Emboozi ey’omukwano eri buli muntu ayimiridde ku mulyango.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ku Mulyango Omufunda kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kwe kukoowoola kwa Charles Spurgeon okumpi era okw’amaanyi eri abo abalwalwanira ebweru w’omulyango gw’obulokozi — abazuukusiddwa, abeeraliikirivu, abaali kumpi okukkirizibwa, naye nga tebannakkiriza. N’ebbugumu lye n’obunkenke bwe ebya bulijjo, aggyawo ebizibu n’okulwisaawo ebikuuma abanoonya nga bayimiridde ku mulyango, era abanyigiriza okuyingira mu ngeri ennyangu: nga beesiga Kristo.

qa.question: 'Omulyango omufunda' ogwogerwako mu mutwe kye ki?
qa.answer: Ekifaananyi kiva mu Olugendo lw’Omutambuze olwa Bunyan, omulyango omufunda gye guba omulyango omufunda ogw’okuyingira mu kkubo ly’obulamu, Omukristaayo gw’alina okuyitamu. Spurgeon akikwata ng’ekifaananyi ky’ekiseera ky’okukkiriza — oluggi olutono era olwangu olw’okwesiga Kristo — era awandiikira bonna abaalusemberera naye nga tebannaluyitamu.

qa.question: Ekitabo kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Abo abaali kumpi okukkirizibwa: abakakasiddwa nti beetaaga, abeeraliikirira emyoyo gyabwe, era abasikirizibwa eri Kristo, naye nga bakugirwa okuwannaanya, okulwisaawo, oba obutategeera. Spurgeon tawandiika kuwoza na batafaayo bafuuke abeeraliikirivu, wabula okuyamba abeeraliikirivu okusala eddaala erisembayo okuyingira mu kukkiriza.

qa.question: Spurgeon ayogera ku bika bya biziyiza ki?
qa.answer: Ebyo ebimanyiddwa ebikuuma abanoonya nga balinze: okulwisaawo n’okulinda 'ekiseera ekisinga okutuukirawo'; okwesiga enneewulira oba okulinda okuwulira ng’abasaanidde ekimala; okutya nti omuntu yayonoona nnyo okusukkiridde; okutabulwa ku kukkiriza kye kuli ddala; n’omuze gw’okuwummulira mu kunenyezebwa mu kifo ky’okujja eri Kristo. Akwata buli kimu mu kifo kyakyo era n’akiggya mpola mu kkubo ly’omunoonya.

qa.question: Spurgeon akubiriza omunoonya kukola ki?
qa.answer: Okukkiriza Kristo kati — okulekera awo okulinda embeera y’omutima esinga obulungi oba enneewulira ey’amaanyi, n’okwesiga obwesizi Omulokozi abayita dda. Ky’addamu buli kiseera kiri nti okukkiriza si mulimu gwa kutuukiriza, wabula kwesigama kwa kukozesa, era nti omulyango guggule eri buli ayagala okujja nga bw’ali.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kifaanana kitya ne Byonna Bya Kisa?
qa.answer: Kye kitabo ekikitambulira ku lusegere — ekirala ku bitabo bya Spurgeon ebimpi eby’enjiri, ekyawandiikibwa mu ddoboozi lye limu ery’ebbugumu, ery’obutereevu, era ery’obusumba. Byonna Bya Kisa bwe kiteeka enjiri mu maaso g’omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu, Ku Mulyango Omufunda kya oyo okusingira ddala eyagiwulira era ali ku nsonga yennyini ey’okusalawo, era byombi bitera okusomebwa n’okugabibwa wamu.

qa.question: Eddoboozi lya Spurgeon liri litya?
qa.answer: Lya kisa era lya bunkenke omulundi gumu. Awandiika ng’omusawo w’emyoyo eyakola n’abanoonya abeeraliikirivu bangi, ng’agumiikiriza okutya kwabwe naye nga tayagala balwisewo, kubanga akkiriza nti akabi k’okulwalwanira kaliwo ddala era okuyita kwa Kristo kwa nkalakkalira. Obunkenke obwo bwa kwagala, so si bwa kunenya.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’akisoma ng’okukoowoola okw’omuntu ku bubwe nga bwe kugendereddwamu. Kimpi nnyo, era kisinga okusomebwa mpola buli anoonya, oba okuweebwa Omukristaayo eri mukwano gwe ayimiridde kumpi n’omulyango — ekigendererwa kyakyo kyonna kwe kuyamba omuntu ng’oyo okusala eddaala erimu ery’okwesiga Kristo.

fields.title: Okuzuukusibwa.
fields.body_html:
Abantu bangi nnyo tebafaayo ku bintu eby’emirembe n’emirembe. Bafaayo nnyo ku bakapa n’embwa zaabwe okusinga emmeeme zaabwe. Kisa kinene nnyo okuleetebwa okulowooza ku ffe ffennyini, ne ku ngeri gye tuyimiriddemu mu maaso ga Katonda ne mu maaso g’ensi etaggwaawo. Emirundi mingi kino kiba kabonero nti obulokozi butusemberera. Mu buzaaliranwa bwaffe tetwagala kweraliikirira okuleetebwa okufaayo ku by’omwoyo, era tugezaako, ng’abagayaavu, okuddamu okwebaka. Buno busirusiru bwa maanyi; kubanga tuba twessa mu kabi bwe tuzannyirira ng’okufa kuli kumpi bwe kuti, era ng’omusango tegulema kujja. Mukama bw’aba nga yatulonda okufuna obulamu obutaggwaawo, tajja kutuleka kuddayo mu tulo twaffe. Bwe tuba ab’amagezi, tujja kusaba okweraliikirira kwaffe olw’emmeeme zaffe kuleme kukoma okutuusa nga ddala era mu mazima tulokoleddwa. Ka twogere okuva mu mitima gyaffe:—

"Oyo eyabonaabona mu kifo kyange, Y’anaaba Omusawo wange; Sijja kukubagizibwa, Okutuusa Yesu lw’alinkubagiza."

Kyandibadde kya ntiisa nnyo okugenda nga tuloota okutuuka mu ggeyeena, ne tutunula waggulu nga tuli eyo, nga waliwo olukonko luwanvu nnyo olutwawula wakati waffe n’eggulu. Kijja kuba kya ntiisa kye kimu okuzuukusibwa okudduka obusungu obugenda okujja, ate oluvannyuma ne twekunkumulako okulabula okwo, ne tuddayo mu butafaayo bwaffe. Ndaba nti abo abawangula okulumirizibwa kw’emitima gyabwe ne beeyongera mu bibi byabwe, omulundi oguddako tebakwatibwako mangu: buli kuzuukusibwa okusuulibwa kuleka emmeeme ng’erina otulo okusinga bwe yali, era nga kizibu okugizuukusa nate mu kuwulira okutukuvu. Noolwekyo emitima gyaffe giteekwa okweraliikirira ennyo bwe tulowooza ku kumalawo obuzibu bwagyo mu ngeri yonna etali ntuufu. Omuntu omu eyalina obulwadde obuluma ennyingo yawonyezebwa eddagala ly’omusawo omulimba, eryazza obulwadde munda, omulwadde n’afa. Okuwonyezebwa ennaku y’omutima olw’essuubi ery’obulimba kyandibadde kintu kya ntiisa: eddagala lyandibadde libi okusinga obulwadde. Kirungi nnyo obugonvu bw’omutima gwaffe ogutulumiriza okutuleetera emyaka emingi egy’obulumi, okusinga okubufiirwa, ne tuzikirira mu bukakanyavu bw’emitima gyaffe.

Naye okuzuukusibwa si kintu kya kuwummuliramu, wadde okwegomba kweyongere omwezi ku mwezi. Bwe nzuukuka nga ntidde, ne nsanga ennyumba yange ng’eyaka omuliro, situula ku mugo gw’ekitanda ne neegamba nti, "Nsuubira nti ddala nzuukusiddwa! Mazima ddala neebaza nnyo kubanga sirekeddwa kweyongera kwebaka!" Nedda, njagala okuwona okufa okuntiisatiisa, kyenva nnyanguwa okudda ku mulyango oba ku ddirisa, nfulume, nneme okuzikiririra we ndi. Kyandibadde kirabo ekibuusibwabuusibwa okuzuukusibwa naye ne sidduka kabi. Jjukira, okuzuukusibwa si bwe bulokozi. Omuntu ayinza okumanya nti abuze, naye n’atalokolebwa n’akatono. Ayinza okufuulibwa omuntu alowooza, naye n’afiira mu bibi bye. Bw’ozuula nti amabanja gakusinze n’otasobola kusasula, okulowooza ku mabanja go tekujja kugasasula. Omuntu ayinza okwekebejja ebiwundu bye omwaka gwonna, naye tebijja kusemberera kuwona olw’okuba awulira obulumi bwabyo, era abibala. Lumu ku nkwe za Setaani kwe kusendasenda omuntu okumatira n’okuwulira ekibi; era olukwe olulala olw’omulimba oyo ye kumuteekamu ekirowoozo nti omwonoonyi tasaanye kumatira kwesiga Kristo, okuggyako nga asobola okuleeta ekigero ekimu eky’okuggwaamu essuubi okukyongera ku mulimu gw’Omulokozi ogwaggwa. Okuzuukusibwa kwaffe si kwa kuyamba Mulokozi, wabula kwa kutuyamba okutuuka eri Omulokozi. Okulowooza nti okuwulira kwange ekibi kulina okuyamba mu kuggyawo ekibi busirusiru. Kiba nga nze ŋŋambye nti amazzi tegayinza kunaaza maaso gange okuggyako nga nnaamala okwetunuulira ennyo mu ndabirwamu, ne mbala amabala ag’enziro ku kyenyi kyange. Okuwulira obwetaavu bw’obulokozi olw’ekisa kabonero kalungi nnyo ak’obulamu; naye omuntu yeetaaga amagezi okukukozesa obulungi, n’obutakufuula kifaananyi kya kusinza.

Abamu balabika ng’abaagala ennyo okubuusabuusa kwabwe, n’okutya kwabwe, n’ennaku yaabwe. Toyinza kubaggya mu ntiisa yaabwe—balabika ng’abagifumbiriganwa nayo. Kigambibwa nti obuzibu obusinga ku mbalaasi ng’ebisibo byazo bikutte omuliro, kwe kuba nti toyinza kuzifulumya mu bifo byazo. Singa zigoberera ggwe azikulembera, zandiwonye ennimi z’omuliro; naye zirabika ng’ezisannyaladdwa okutya. Bwe kityo okutya omuliro kuziremesa okuwona omuliro. Musomi, okutya kwo okungi obusungu obugenda okujja kunaakulemesa okubuwona? Tusuubira nti nedda.

Omusibe omu eyali amaze ebbanga ddene mu kkomera teyayagala kufuluma. Oluggi lwali luggule; naye yeegayirira, n’amaziga, bamukkirize okusigala we yali amaze ebbanga eryo lyonna. Okwagala ekkomera! Okufumbiriganwa n’ebyuma ebisiba n’emmere y’omu kkomera! Mazima omusibe oyo yali akoseddwa katono ku bwongo! Oyagala okusigala ng’omuntu azuukusiddwa bwazuukusibwa, awatali kirala? Tolina kwegomba kusonyiyibwa mangu ago? Bw’oba oyagala okulwawo mu bulumi n’entiisa, mazima naawe oteekwa okuba ng’oyonoonese katono ku magezi! Bwe kiba nga emirembe gisobola okufunibwa, gifune mangu ago! Lwaki olwawo mu kizikiza ky’ekinnya, ebigere byo mwe bitubira mu bitosi? Waliwo omusana ogw’okufuna; omusana ogw’ekitalo era ogw’omu ggulu; lwaki ogalamira mu kizikiza n’ofiira mu bulumi? Tomanyi bulokozi nga bwe buli kumpi naawe. Singa obadde omanyi, mazima wandigolodde omukono gwo n’obutwala, kubanga buli awo; era bufunibwa ku kubutwala obutwazi.

Tolowooza nti okuwulira okuggwaamu essuubi kujja kukusaanyiza okusaasirwa. Omutambuze, ng’agenda eri Omulyango Omufunda, bwe yagwa mu Kidiba ky’Okuggwaamu Essuubi, olowooza nti ebitosi ebikyafu eby’ekidiba ekyo bwe byakwatira ku ngoye ze, byamusemba, okumufunyisa okuyingira amangu ku ntandikwa y’ekkubo? Si bwe kiri. Omutambuze teyalowooza bw’atyo n’akatono; naawe tosaanye kulowooza bw’otyo. Si ekyo ggwe ky’owulira ekijja okukulokola, wabula ekyo Yesu kye yawulira. Ne bwe wandibaddewo omugaso ogw’okuwonya mu kuwulira, kwandibadde kuteekwa kuba kuwulira okulungi; era okuwulira okutuleetera okubuusabuusa amaanyi ga Kristo okulokola, era okutulemesa okufuna obulokozi mu ye, si kulungi n’akatono, wabula kye kibi eky’obukambwe eri okwagala kwa Yesu.

Mukwano gwaffe azze okutulaba, era atambudde mu Londoni yaffe ejjudde abantu, ng’ali ku ggaali y’omukka, oba ku ttulaamu, oba mu bbaasi. Amangu ago amaaso ge gaggwaamu omusaayi. Tumubuuza ekimuli, n’addamu nti, "Mbuzizza akasawo kange ak’ensimbi, era kaalimu ensimbi zonna ze nnina mu nsi." Azibala okutuuka ku ssente esembayo, era annyonnyola ceeke, n’empapula z’amabanja, n’ensimbi ez’empapula, n’ez’ebyuma. Tumugamba nti kiteekwa okuba ekimubudaabuda ennyo okumanya obulungi bwe butyo obunene bw’ekyo ky’afiiriddwa. Talabika kulaba mugaso gwa kubudaabuda kwaffe. Tumukakasa nti ateekwa okwebaza olw’okuba amanyi bulungi bwe butyo ekyo ky’afiiriddwa; kubanga abantu bangi bandibuzizza obusawo bwabwe obw’ensimbi ne batasobola n’akatono kubala bye bafiiriddwa. Naye mukwano gwaffe tasanyuka n’akatono. "Nedda," bw’agamba, "okumanya kye mfiiriddwa tekinnyamba kukizzaawo. Mbuulira we nnyinza okusanga ebyange, olwo ng’onkoledde obuweereza obwa ddala; naye okumanya obumanya bye mfiiriddwa si kubudaabuda n’akatono." Bwe kityo, okukkiriza nti oyonoonye, era nti emmeeme yo egwanidde okutwalibwa obwenkanya bwa Katonda, kintu kituufu nnyo; naye tekijja kulokola. Obulokozi tebuva mu kumanya kuzikirira kwaffe, wabula mu kukwata ddala obununuzi obwategekebwa mu Kristo Yesu. Omuntu agaana okutunuulira Mukama Yesu, naye n’akakaatira okulowooza ku kibi kye n’okuzikirira kwe, atujjukiza omulenzi eyasuula esiringi mu kituli ekiggule eky’omukutu gw’enziro e Londoni, n’asigala awo okumala essaawa nnyingi, ng’abudaabudibwa okugamba nti, "Yayiringitira wano wennyini! Wakati w’ebyuma bino ebibiri wennyini we nagiraba ng’ekka!" Omwana omwavu! Yandimaze ebbanga ddene ng’ajjukira ebikwata ku kufiirwa kwe, nga tannaba kuzzaayo, mu ngeri eyo, ssente n’emu mu nsawo ye, gy’asobola okwegulira akatole k’omugaati. Olaba amakulu g’olugero luno; luganyulwemu.

Ne bwe wandibaddewo omugaso ogw’okuwonya mu kuwulira, kwandibadde kuteekwa kuba kuwulira okulungi; era okuwulira okutuleetera okubuusabuusa amaanyi ga Kristo okulokola, era okutulemesa okufuna obulokozi mu ye, si kulungi n’akatono, wabula kye kibi eky’obukambwe eri okwagala kwa Yesu. Mukwano gwaffe azze okutulaba, era atambudde mu Londoni yaffe ejjudde abantu, ng’ali ku ggaali y’omukka, oba ku ttulaamu, oba mu bbaasi. Amangu ago amaaso ge gaggwaamu omusaayi. Tumubuuza ekimuli, n’addamu nti, "Mbuzizza akasawo kange ak’ensimbi, era kaalimu ensimbi zonna ze nnina mu nsi." Azibala okutuuka ku ssente esembayo, era annyonnyola ceeke, n’empapula z’amabanja, n’ensimbi ez’empapula, n’ez’ebyuma. Tumugamba nti kiteekwa okuba ekimubudaabuda ennyo okumanya obulungi bwe butyo obunene bw’ekyo ky’afiiriddwa. Talabika kulaba mugaso gwa kubudaabuda kwaffe. Naye mukwano gwaffe tasanyuka n’akatono. "Nedda," bw’agamba, "okumanya kye mfiiriddwa tekinnyamba kukizzaawo. fields.title: Yesu yekka.
fields.body_html:
Tetuyinza, emirundi emingi ennyo oba mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, okugamba emmeeme enoonya nti essuubi lyayo lyokka ery’obulokozi liri mu Mukama Yesu Kristo. Liri mu ye mu bujjuvu, mu ye yekka, era ye yekka. Okulokola okuva mu musango ne mu maanyi g’ekibi, Yesu amala ddala. Erinnya lye ayitibwa Yesu, kubanga "y’alirokola abantu bonna mu bibi byabwe." "Omwana w’Omuntu alina obuyinza ku nsi okusonyiwa ebibi." Yagulumizibwa waggulu okuwa "omukisa ogw’okwenenya n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi." Katonda kyamusanyusa okuva edda n’edda okuteekateeka engeri y’obulokozi eyandizingiddwa yonna mu Mwana we omu yekka. Mukama Yesu, olw’okutuukiriza obulokozi buno, yafuuka omuntu, n’alabikira mu kifaananyi ky’omuntu, n’aba muwulize n’okutuukira ddala ku kufa, ate okufa okw’okukomererwa ku musaalaba. Singa wabaddewo engeri endala ey’okununulibwa, ekikompe eky’obukaawu kyandimuyiseeko. Kya magezi okutegeera nti omwagalwa w’eggulu teyandifudde kutulokola singa twali tusobola okununulibwa ku muwendo omutono. Ekisa ekitaliiko kkomo kye kyategeka ssaddaaka enkulu; okwagala okutaliiko kkomo kwe kwakkiriza okufa ku lwaffe. Tuyinza tutya okuloota nti wayinza okubaawo engeri endala okuggyako engeri Katonda gye yategeka ku muwendo omunene bwe gutyo, n’agiraga mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu mu ngeri ennyangu bw’etyo era ey’okukubiriza bw’etyo? Mazima kya mazima nti "Tewali mu mulala yenna bulokozi, era tewali linnya ddala na limu mu mannya gonna agaaweebwa abantu, wansi w’eggulu, mwetugwanira okulokolebwa."

Okulowooza nti Mukama Yesu yalokolako bantu kitundu kyokka, era nti weetaagibwa omulimu oba okuwulira kwabwe bo bennyini okumaliriza omulimu gwe, buba bubi bwennyini. Kiki ku byaffe ekiyinza okwongerwa ku musaayi gwe ne ku butuukirivu bwe? "obutuukirivu bwaffe buli nga nziina ezijjudde obukyafu." Zino ziyinza okutungibwa ku lugoye olw’omuwendo olw’obutuukirivu bwe obw’obwakatonda? Enziina n’olugoye olweru olulungi ennyo! Ebisasiro byaffe ne zaabu ye ennongoofu! Kivuma Omulokozi okuloota ekintu ng’ekyo. Twayonoona ekimala, awatali kwongera kino ku bisobyo byaffe ebirala byonna.

Ne bwe twandibadde n’obutuukirivu bwonna bwe twandyenyumiririzaamu; singa ebikoola byaffe eby’omutiini byali bigazi okusinga bulijjo, era nga tebiwotoka nnyo bwe bityo, kyandibadde kya magezi okubiteeka ebbali, ne tukkiriza obutuukirivu obwo obuteekwa okusanyusa Katonda ennyo okusinga ekintu kyonna ekyaffe. Mukama ateekwa okulaba mu Mwana we ebisiimibwa bingi okusinga mu asinga obulungi mu ffe. Asinga obulungi mu ffe! Ebigambo bino birabika ng’eby’okujerega, newankubadde si bwe byagendererwa. Bulungi ki obusinga obuli mu muntu yenna mu ffe? "teri akola kirungi, era teri n’omu." Nze awandiika ennyiriri zino, nandyatudde n’omwoyo gwonna nti sirina wadde akawuzi k’obulungi akange nze. Sisobola kukola wadde enziina, wadde ekitundu ky’enziina. Siriiko kantu n’akamu. Naye singa nnali n’ekyambalo ekisinga obulungi eky’ebikolwa ebirungi amalala ge gayinza okulowooza, nandikiyuzizza ndyoke nneme kwambala kirala kyonna wabula ebyambalo eby’obulokozi, ebiweebwa obwereere Mukama Yesu, okuva mu ggwanika ery’omu ggulu ery’obulungi bwe ye yennyini.

Kiwa nnyo Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ekitiibwa bwe tusuubira buli kirungi okuva gy’ali yekka. Kuno kwe kumuyisa nga bw’asaanidde okuyisibwa; kubanga nga bw’ali Katonda, so nga tewali mulala, tuteekwa okumudda tulokoke.

Kuno kwe kumuyisa nga bw’ayagala okuyisibwa, kubanga ayita bonna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa okujja gy’ali, era alibawummuza. Okulowooza nti tayinza okulokolera ddala abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe, kubanga abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okubawolereza. kuba kukomya Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri, n’okunyooma amaanyi ge; oba okuwaayiriza omutima ogw’okwagala ogwa Mukwano gw’abonoonyi, n’okubuusabuusa okwagala kwe. Mu ngeri zombi, twandikoze ekibi eky’obukambwe era eky’obwemage ku bitundu ebisinga obugonvu eby’ekitiibwa kye, bye bino: obusobozi bwe n’okwagala kwe okulokola bonna abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe.

Omwana, ng’ali mu kabi k’omuliro, yeekwata bwekwasi ku muzimya w’omuliro, era amwesiga yekka. Tabuuza kibuuzo kyonna ku maanyi g’emikono gye okumusitula, oba ku bunyiikivu bw’omutima gwe okumuwonya; wabula yeekwata. Ebbugumu lya ntiisa, omukka guziba amaaso, naye yeekwata; era omununuzi we amangu ddala amutwala mu kifo eky’obukuumi. Mu bwesige obwo bwe bumu obw’omwana omuto, weekwate ku Yesu, asobola era ajja okukuggya mu kabi k’ennimi z’omuliro gw’ekibi.

Obutonde bwa Mukama Yesu bwanditutadde mu bwesige obujjuvu. Nga bw’ali Katonda, wa maanyi gonna okulokola; nga bw’ali omuntu, ajjudde obujjuvu bwonna okuwa omukisa; nga bw’ali Katonda era omuntu mu Muntu omu ow’Ekitiibwa, asisinkana omuntu mu bwetonde bwe, era asisinkana Katonda mu butukuvu bwe. Amadaala mawanvu ekimala okutuuka okuva ku Yakobo eyeegalamidde ku ttaka, okutuuka ku Mukama afugira mu ggulu. Okuleeta amadaala amalala kwandibadde kulowooza nti yalemwa okuyunga ebbanga eryo; era kino kyandibadde kumuswaza nnyo. Obanga n’okwongera ku bigambo bye kwe kwesikira ekikolimo, kale kiba kitya okwefuula okwongera ku ye yennyini? Jjukira nti ye yennyini, ye Kkubo; era okulowooza nti tuteekwa, mu ngeri emu oba endala, okwongera ku kkubo ery’obwakatonda, kuba kwekulumbaza okw’okulowooza okwongera ku ye. Ekirowoozo ng’ekyo kiggweewo! Kikyawe nga bwe wandikyaye okuvvoola; kubanga mu buziba bwakyo kye kivvoolo ekisingirayo ddala obubi eri Mukama ow’okwagala.

Okujja eri Yesu nga tulina omuwendo mu ngalo zaffe kwandibadde malala agatagumiikirizika, ne bwe twandibadde n’omuwendo gwonna gwe tuyinza okuleeta. Atwetaagako ki? Twandireese ki singa yali akyetaaga? Yandiguzizza emikisa egy’obununuzi bwe egitalina muwendo? Ekyo kye yatuukiriza mu musaayi gw’omutima gwe, yandikiwanyisizza naffe olw’amaziga gaffe, n’obweyamo, oba olw’emikolo egy’eddiini, n’okuwulira, n’ebikolwa? Tatuuse ku kwefuula kya kutunda mu katale: awa bwereere, nga bwe kisaanira okwagala kwe okw’obwakabaka; naye oyo amuwa omuwendo tamanyi gw’akolagana naye, wadde engeri gy’anyiiza ennyo Omwoyo we ow’ekisa eky’obwereere. Abonoonyi abatalina kantu mu ngalo bayinza okufuna kye baagala kyonna. Byonna bye bayinza okwetaaga biri mu Yesu, era abiwa ng’abisabiddwa obusabibwa; naye tuteekwa okukkiriza nti ye byonna mu byonna, era tetuteekwa kwetantala kwogera kigambo na kimu ku kumaliriza kye yamaliriza, oba ku kwesaanyiza bye atuwa ng’abonoonyi abatasaanira.

Ensonga lwaki tuyinza okusuubira okusonyiyibwa ebibi, n’obulamu obutaggwaawo, olw’okukkiriza Mukama Yesu, kwe kuba nti Katonda bw’atyo bwe yateekawo. Yeesiba mu njiri okulokola bonna abeesiga ddala Mukama Yesu, era taliddirira ku kisuubizo kye. Asanyukira nnyo Omwana we omu yekka, ne kiba nti asanyukira bonna abamukwata nga lye ssuubi lyabwe limu lyokka. Katonda omukulu yennyini akutte oyo akutte Omwana we. Akolera obulokozi bonna abasuubira obulokozi obwo okuva eri Omununuzi eyattibwa omulundi gumu. Olw’ekitiibwa ky’Omwana we, tajja kukkiriza muntu amwesiga kuswala. "Oyo akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo;" kubanga Katonda omulamu ennaku zonna amutwala gy’ali, era amuwadde okugabana ku bulamu bwe. Yesu yekka bw’aba nga gw’oyesiga, tolina kutya nti tolirokolebwa ddala, kati ne ku lunaku lw’okulabika kwe.

Omuntu bw’ayesiga, wabaawo ekifo eky’okugatta wakati we ne Katonda, era okugatta okwo kukakasa omukisa. Okukkiriza kutulokola kubanga kutuleetera okwekwata ku Kristo Yesu, era ye ali omu ne Katonda, bw’atyo atuyunga ku Katonda. Bangamba nti, emyaka mingi emabega, waggulu w’Ebiyiriro bya Niagara, eryato lyavuunika, abasajja babiri ne batwalibwa omukulukuto, abantu abaali ku lubalama ne basobola okubasindikira omuguwa ku mazzi, ne gukwatibwa bombi. Omu ku bo yagunywezaako, n’asikibwa n’atuuka ku lubalama nga mulamu; naye omulala, bwe yalaba ekisiki ekinene nga kiyitawo nga kiseeyeeya, mu butali bwa magezi n’ata omuguwa, ne yeekwata ku kisiki ekyo ekinene, kubanga kye kyali ekisinga obunene mu bibiri, era nga kirabika kisinga okwekwatibwako. Woowe! Ekisiki, n’omusajja ng’akiriko, ne kigwa mu bunnya obunene ennyo, kubanga tewaaliwo kuyungibwa wakati w’omuti n’olubalama. Obunene bw’ekisiki tebwagasa oyo eyakikwata; kyali kyetaaga okuyungibwa ku lubalama okuleeta obukuumi. Bwe kityo, omuntu bw’ayesiga ebikolwa bye, oba essaala ze, oba ebirabo bye eri abaavu, oba amasakalamentu, oba ekintu kyonna eky’engeri eyo, tajja kulokolebwa, kubanga tewali kuyungibwa wakati we ne Katonda okuyita mu Kristo Yesu; naye okukkiriza, newankubadde kuyinza okulabika ng’akaguwa akatono, kuli mu mukono gwa Katonda omukulu ku ludda lw’olubalama; amaanyi agataliiko kkomo gasika omuguwa ogugatta, bwe gatyo ne gaggya omuntu mu kuzikirira. Ai, omukisa gw’okukkiriza, kubanga kutugatta ku Katonda okuyita mu Mulokozi gwe yalonda, ye Yesu Kristo! Ai musomi, mu nsonga eno temuli magezi ga bulijjo? Kirowoozeeko, era ka mangu wabeewo omukago ogw’okugatta wakati wo ne Katonda, olw’okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo Yesu!

Asanyukira nnyo Omwana we omu yekka, ne kiba nti asanyukira bonna abamukwata nga lye ssuubi lyabwe limu lyokka. Katonda omukulu yennyini akutte oyo akutte Omwana we. Akolera obulokozi bonna abasuubira obulokozi obwo okuva eri Omununuzi eyattibwa omulundi gumu. Olw’ekitiibwa ky’Omwana we, tajja kukkiriza muntu amwesiga kuswala. "Oyo akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo;" kubanga Katonda omulamu ennaku zonna amutwala gy’ali, era amuwadde okugabana ku bulamu bwe. Yesu yekka bw’aba nga gw’oyesiga, tolina kutya nti tolirokolebwa ddala, kati ne ku lunaku lw’okulabika kwe. Omuntu bw’ayesiga, wabaawo ekifo eky’okugatta wakati we ne Katonda, era okugatta okwo kukakasa omukisa. Okukkiriza kutulokola kubanga kutuleetera okwekwata ku Kristo Yesu, era ye ali omu ne Katonda, bw’atyo atuyunga ku Katonda. Bangamba nti, emyaka mingi emabega, waggulu w’Ebiyiriro bya Niagara, eryato lyavuunika, abasajja babiri ne batwalibwa omukulukuto, abantu abaali ku lubalama ne basobola okubasindikira omuguwa ku mazzi, ne gukwatibwa bombi. Omu ku bo yagunywezaako, n’asikibwa n’atuuka ku lubalama nga mulamu; naye omulala, bwe yalaba ekisiki ekinene nga kiyitawo nga kiseeyeeya, mu butali bwa magezi n’ata omuguwa, ne yeekwata ku kisiki ekyo ekinene, kubanga kye kyali ekisinga obunene mu bibiri, era nga kirabika kisinga okwekwatibwako. Woowe! Ekisiki, n’omusajja ng’akiriko, ne kigwa mu bunnya obunene ennyo, kubanga tewaaliwo kuyungibwa wakati w’omuti n’olubalama. Obunene bw’ekisiki tebwagasa oyo eyakikwata; kyali kyetaaga okuyungibwa ku lubalama okuleeta obukuumi. Bwe kityo, omuntu bw’ayesiga ebikolwa bye, oba essaala ze, oba ebirabo bye eri abaavu, oba amasakalamentu, oba ekintu kyonna eky’engeri eyo, tajja kulokolebwa, kubanga tewali kuyungibwa wakati we ne Katonda okuyita mu Kristo Yesu; naye okukkiriza, newankubadde kuyinza okulabika ng’akaguwa akatono, kuli mu mukono gwa Katonda omukulu ku ludda lw’olubalama; amaanyi agataliiko kkomo gasika omuguwa ogugatta, bwe gatyo ne gaggya omuntu mu kuzikirira. Ai, omukisa gw’okukkiriza, kubanga kutugatta ku Katonda okuyita mu Mulokozi gwe yalonda, ye Yesu Kristo! Ai musomi, mu nsonga eno temuli magezi ga bulijjo? Kirowoozeeko, era ka mangu wabeewo omukago ogw’okugatta wakati wo ne Katonda, olw’okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo Yesu!

fields.title: Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Yennyini.
fields.body_html:
Waliwo omuze omubi mu bantu ogw’okuleka Kristo yennyini ebweru w’enjiri. Kyandibadde kye kimu n’okuleka obuwunga ebweru w’omugaati. Abantu bawulira ekkubo ly’obulokozi nga linnyonnyolwa, ne bakkiriza nti lya mu Byawandiikibwa, era mu buli ngeri nga lisaanira embeera yaabwe; naye beerabira nti enteekateeka tegasa okuggyako ng’etuukirizibwa; era nti mu nsonga y’obulokozi, okukkiriza kwabwe bo bennyini mu Mukama Yesu kwetaagisa ddala. Ekkubo erigenda e York teriintwalayo; nteekwa okulitambuliramu nze kennyini. Enjigiriza yonna entuufu eyali ekkiriziddwa tejja kulokola muntu okuggyako ng’ateeka obwesige bwe mu Mukama Yesu ye kennyini.

Omwami Macdonald yabuuza abatuuze b’ekizinga St. Kilda omuntu bw’ateekwa okulokolebwa. Omusajja omukadde yaddamu nti, "Tulirokolebwa bwe twenenya, ne tuleka ebibi byaffe, ne tukyukira Katonda." "Weewaawo," bwe yagamba omukazi ow’emyaka egy’omu makkati, "era n’omutima ogw’amazima." "Ye," bwe yayongerako ow’okusatu, "era n’okusaba"; n’ow’okuna n’ayongerako nti, "Kuteekwa kuba kusaba kwa mutima." "Era tuteekwa n’okunyiikira," bwe yagamba ow’okutaano, "mu kukwata amateeka." Bwe batyo, buli omu bwe yamala okuwaayo akatono ke, nga bawulira nti bakoze enzikiriza ennungi ddala, bonna ne batunula era ne bawuliriza okusiima kw’omubuulizi; naye baali bamuleetedde okusaasira okusingirayo ddala: yalina okutandikira ku ntandikwa, n’ababuulira Kristo. Endowooza ey’omubiri bulijjo yeekubira ekkubo omuntu ye kennyini mw’asobola okukolera n’afuuka omukulu; naye ekkubo lya Mukama lya njawulo ddala. Mukama Yesu alyogera mu bufunze mu Makko 16:16: "Abo bonna abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa." Okukkiriza n’okubatizibwa si bikolwa bya kusaanyiza bye tuyinza okwenyumiririzaamu; byangu nnyo ne kiba nti okwenyumiriza kuggyibwawo, era ekisa eky’obwereere kye kiwangula. Ekkubo lino ery’obulokozi lyalondebwa lyoleke nti lya kisa kyokka. Kiyinzika okuba nti omusomi tannalokolebwa: nsonga ki? Olowooza nti ekkubo ly’obulokozi, nga bwe liragiddwa mu kyawandiikibwa kye tujulizza, lya kubuusabuusa? Otya nti tewandirokoleddwa singa wandirigoberedde? Ekyo kiyinza kitya okubaawo, nga Katonda yeeyimiridde n’ekigambo kye ku bukakafu bwalyo? Kiyinza kitya okulemwa ekyo Katonda ky’alagira, era ky’akwasizza ekisuubizo? Olowooza nti kyangu nnyo? Kale lwaki tokikola? Obwangu bwakyo buleka abakiragajjalira nga tebalina kya kwekwasa. Singa wandikoze ekintu ekinene, tobeera musirusiru ow’okulagajjalira ekintu ekitono. Okukkiriza kwe kwesiga, oba okwesigama ku Kristo Yesu; mu bigambo ebirala, okulekera awo okwesiga wekka, ne weesigama ku Mukama Yesu. Okubatizibwa kwe kugondera omukolo Mukama waffe gwe yatuukiriza ku Yoludaani, abakyuse gwe baagondera ku Pentekooti, omukuumi w’ekkomera gwe yagondera mu kiro kyennyini kye yakyusibwamu. Kwe kwatula okw’ebweru okuteekwa bulijjo okugenda n’okukkiriza okw’omunda. Akabonero ak’ebweru tekalokola; naye katulaga okufa kwaffe, okuziikibwa kwaffe, n’okuzuukira kwaffe wamu ne Yesu, era, ng’Ekyeggulo kya Mukama, tekasaanye kulagajjalirwa.

Ensonga enkulu kwe kukkiriza Yesu, n’okwatula okukkiriza kwo. Okkiriza Yesu? Kale, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, leka okutya kwo; ojja kulokolebwa. Okyali mutakkiriza? Kale jjukira, waliwo oluggi lumu lwokka, era bw’otoluyingiramu, oteekwa kuzikiririra mu bibi byo. Oluggi luli awo; naye okuggyako ng’oluyingiddemu, lukugasa ki? Kya bwetaavu ggwe okugondera ekiragiro ky’enjiri. Tewali kiyinza kukulokola bw’otowulira ddoboozi lya Yesu, n’okola ky’alagira mu mazima ddala. Okulowooza n’okumalirira tebijja kumala; oteekwa okukikola ddala; kubanga ojja kuba mulamu ddala eri Katonda bw’onookkiriza ddala kyokka.

Nawulira ku mukwano gwange eyali yeegomba nnyo okuba ekkubo ery’okukyusa omuvubuka, omuntu omu n’amugamba nti, "Oyinza okugenda gy’ali, n’oyogera naye, naye tojja kumutwala wala; kubanga amanyi nnyo enteekateeka y’obulokozi." Kyali bwe kityo ddala; era kyeyava, mukwano gwaffe bwe yatandika okwogera n’omuvubuka, n’afuna okuddibwamu nti, "Nkwebaza nnyo, naye simanyi oba olina bingi by’oyinza okumbuulira, kubanga mbadde mmanyi okuva edda era nga nsiima enteekateeka y’obulokozi okuyita mu ssaddaaka ya Kristo eyafiirira mu kifo kyaffe." Woowe! Yali awummulidde mu nteekateeka, naye nga tannakkiriza Oyo Yennyini. Enteekateeka y’obulokozi erimu omukisa mungi, naye tesobola kutugasa kintu kyonna okuggyako nga tukkiriza ffe ffennyini Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini. Enteekateeka y’ennyumba ekubudaabuda etya bw’otayingira mu nnyumba yennyini? Omusajja ali mu kifaananyi kyaffe, atudde wabweru mu nkuba, tafuna kubudaabudibwa kungi okuva mu nteekateeka ezimwanjuluziddwa mu maaso ge. Enteekateeka y’engoye egasa ki bw’oba tolina wadde enziina ey’okwebikka? Tewawulirangako ku mukulu w’Abawalabu e Kayiro, eyali omulwadde ennyo, n’agenda eri omuminsani, omuminsani n’amugamba nti asobola okumuwandiikira eddagala? Yakikola; era oluvannyuma lwa wiiki emu n’asanga Omuwalabu nga tannatereera n’akatono. Wakozesezza bye nakuwandiikira?" bwe yamubuuza. "Weewaawo, nalidde buli katundu k’olupapula." Yaloota nti agenda kuwonyezebwa olw’okulya ebiwandiiko by’omusawo, bye nnyinza okuyita enteekateeka y’eddagala. Yandibadde atwala ebyawandiikibwa ne bimukolerwako eddagala, olwo ne liyinza okumugasa, singa yalinywa: tekyandimugasizza n’akatono okumira olupapula lw’eddagala. Bwe kiri bwe kityo n’obulokozi: si nteekateeka ya bulokozi eyinza okulokola, wabula kwe kutuukiriza enteekateeka eyo Mukama Yesu kwe yakola mu kufa kwe ku lwaffe, n’okukkiriza kwaffe ekyo. Wansi w’amateeka g’Abayudaaya, oyo eyawangayo ssaddaaka yaleetanga ente ennume, n’agiteekako emikono gye: tekyali kirooto, wadde endowooza, wadde enteekateeka. Mu nsolo ey’okuwaayo ssaddaaka yasangangamu ekintu ekyaddala, kye yasobolanga okukwata n’okukomako: era naffe bwe tutyo twesigama ku mulimu ogwa ddala era ogw’amazima ogwa Yesu, ekintu ekisinga obwa ddala wansi w’eggulu. Tujja eri Mukama Yesu olw’okukkiriza, ne tugamba nti, "Katonda ateeseteese okutangirira wano, era nkukkiriza. Nzikiriza ekyakolebwa ku musaalaba; nkakasa nti ekibi kyaggyibwawo Kristo, era nneesigama ku ye." Bw’oba oyagala okulokolebwa, oteekwa okusukka okukkiriza enteekateeka n’enjigiriza, n’otuuka ku kuwummulira mu Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini ow’obwakatonda, ne mu mulimu gwe ogwaggwa. Musomi omwagalwa, onoosembeza Kristo kati?

Yesu ayita bonna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa okujja gy’ali, era alibawummuza. Kino takisuubiza abo abamulootako obulootazi. Bateekwa okujja; era bateekwa okujja GY’ALI YE, so si mu Kkanisa bujja, oba mu kubatizibwa, oba mu kukkiriza okutuufu, oba eri ekintu kyonna ekitatuuka ku ye yennyini ow’obwakatonda. Omusota ogw’ekikomo bwe gwawanikibwa mu ddungu, abantu tebaalina kutunuulira Musa, wadde Eweema, wadde empagi ey’ekire, wabula omusota ogw’ekikomo gwennyini. Okutunula tekwamala okuggyako nga batunuulira ekintu ekituufu: era ekintu ekituufu tekyamala okuggyako nga batunuulidde. Tekyabamala kumanya bumanya ku musota ogw’ekikomo; buli omu yali ateekwa okugutunuulira ye kennyini. Omuntu bw’aba omulwadde, ayinza okuba ng’amanyi bulungi eby’eddagala, naye n’afa bw’atanywa ddala ddagala eriwonya. Tuteekwa okusembeza Yesu; kubanga "bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda." Teeka essira ku bigambo bibiri: Tuteekwa okusembeza YE, era tuteekwa OKUMUSEMBEZA ye. Tuteekwa okuggulawo ennyo oluggi, ne tuyingiza Kristo Yesu; kubanga "Kristo abeera mu mmwe" ye "essuubi ery’ekitiibwa." Kristo tateekwa kuba gye tuli lugero lwa bufuusa, wadde ekirooto, wadde ekisiikirize, wabula omuntu owa ddala, era Katonda ddala; era okumusembeza kwaffe tekuteekwa kuba kwa kukakibwa oba kwa bulimba, wabula okukkiriza n’okukkiriziganya okw’omutima gwonna era okw’essanyu okw’emmeeme nti ye anaaba byonna mu byonna eby’obulokozi bwaffe. Tetujja mangu ago kujja gy’ali, ne tumufuula obwesige bwaffe bwokka?

Ejjiba liyiggibwa kamunye, era terifuna bukuumi okuva eri omulabe waalyo atawummula. Liyize nti waliwo obuddukiro bwalyo mu njatika y’olwazi, era lyanguwa okugendayo n’ebiwaawaatiro eby’essanyu. Bwe limala okwekweka ddala mu buddukiro bwalyo, teritya nnyonyi yonna eyiggana. Naye singa teryekweka mu lwazi, lyandikwatiddwa omulabe waalyo. Olwazi terwandigasizza jjiba, singa ejjiba teryayingira mu njatika yaalwo. Omubiri gwonna gulina okukwekebwa mu lwazi. Ne bwe zandibaddewo ennyonyi endala emitwalo kkumi ezaafuna ekigo awo, ekyo tekyandirokodde jjiba eryo limu kamunye ly’ayigga kati! Liteekwa okuteeka ddala bwonna bwalyo mu buddukiro, ne lyeziika mu kifo kyalyo eky’obuddukiro, oba obulamu bwalyo bunaatwalibwa omuzikiriza.

Nga kino kifaananyi kya kukkiriza! Kwe kuyingira mu Yesu, okwekweka mu biwundu bye.

"Lwazi lw’Emirembe, eyayatikira ku lwange, Ka nneekweke mu ggwe."

Ejjiba terikyalabika: olwazi lwokka lwe lulabika. Bw’etyo emmeeme ey’omusango bw’efubutuka n’eyingira mu mbiriizi za Yesu ezaafumitibwa, olw’okukkiriza, n’eziikibwa mu ye, obwenkanya obuwoolera eggwanga ne butakyagiraba. Naye walina okubaawo okuddukira kuno okw’omuntu kennyini eri Yesu okufuna obuddukiro; era kino kye bangi kye bongezaayo buli lunaku, okutuusa lwe kitiibwa nti "balifiira mu bibi byabwe." Ekigambo ekyo nga kya ntiisa! Kye kyo Mukama waffe kye yagamba Abayudaaya abatakkiriza; era akigamba ffe mu kiseera kino kyennyini: "bwe mutakkiriza nti nze wuuyo, Omwana wa Katonda, mulifiira mu bibi byammwe." Kikankanya omutima gw’omuntu okulowooza nti ne bw’aba omu yekka anaasoma ennyiriri zino ayinza okuba mu kibiina eky’ennaku ekijja okuzikirira bwe kityo. Mukama akiziyize olw’ekisa kye ekinene!

Ennaku ziri, nalaba ekifaananyi eky’ekitalo, kye nnaakozesa okulaga ekkubo ly’obulokozi olw’okukkiriza Yesu. Omusobya yali azizza omusango ogwali gumugwanira okufa, naye kyali mu biseera eby’edda, amakanisa bwe gaali gatwalibwa ng’ebifo eby’obuddukiro abamenyi b’amateeka mwe baasobolanga okwekweka, ne bawona okufa. Laba omusobya! Afubutuka ng’adda eri ekkanisa, abakuumi bamugoba n’ebitala byabwe nga babisowodde, nga balumwa ennyonta y’omusaayi gwe! Bamugoberera okutuuka ne ku mulyango gw’ekkanisa. Ayanguwa n’alinnya amadaala, era bwe baba banaatera okumutuukako, bamutemetemere ku mulyango gw’ekkanisa, Omulabirizi n’afuluma, n’ayimusa omusaalaba, n’akaaba nti, "Mudde emabega, mudde emabega! Temwonoona kifo kya nnyumba ya Katonda na musaayi! Mudde emabega!" Abaserikale abakambwe amangu ago ne bassaamu ekitiibwa akabonero ako, ne badda emabega, ate omubunyi omwavu ne yeekweka emabega w’ebyambalo by’Omulabirizi. Bwe kiri ne Kristo. Omwonoonyi ali mu musango adduka butereevu eri Yesu; era newankubadde Obwenkanya bumugoba, Kristo ayimusa emikono gye egyafumitibwa, n’akaabira Obwenkanya nti, "Dda emabega! Omwonoonyi ono mmuwa obuddukiro; mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’eweema yange mwe mmukweka; sijja kumuleka kuzikirira, kubanga yeesiga nze." Mwonoonyi, ddukira eri Kristo! Naye oddamu nti, "Ndi mubi nnyo." Gy’okoma okuba omubi, gy’ojja okukoma okumuwa ekitiibwa ng’okkiriza nti asobola okukuuma ne ggwe. "Naye ndi mwonoonyi munene nnyo." Kale ekitiibwa ekingi kijja kumuweebwa bw’onoobaako n’okukkiriza okumwesiga, newankubadde oli mwonoonyi munene. Bw’oba n’akalwadde akatono, n’ogamba omusawo wo nti—"Ssebo, nneesiga nnyo obukugu bwo okuwonya," tewali kitiibwa kinene mu kwogera kwo okwo. Buli muntu asobola okuwonya olunwe oluluma, oba akalwadde akatono. Naye bw’oba ng’oli mulwadde nnyo n’endwadde nnyingi ezikubonyaabonya ennyo, n’ogamba nti—"Ssebo, sinoonya musawo amusinga; sijja kubuuza magezi galala wabula ago go; nneewaayo gy’oli n’essanyu;" nga omuwadde ekitiibwa kinene, olw’okusobola okuteeka obulamu bwo mu mikono gye nga buli mu kabi akanene era ak’amangu! Kolera bw’otyo ne Kristo; teeka emmeeme yo mu mikono gye: kikole ng’omaliridde, era awatali kubuusabuusa. Weetantale okuleka amasuubi amalala gonna: weetantale ne byonna ku Yesu; ŋŋamba nti "weetantale" newankubadde mu mazima temuli kabi konna mu kyo, kubanga asobola nnyo okulokola. Weesuule ku Yesu bwesuuzi; mu mmeeme yo temubanga kirala kyonna eri Yesu wabula okukkiriza; mukkirize, era omwesige, era tolikwatibwa nsonyi n’akatono olw’obwesige bwo. "oyo eyeesiga Kristo, taliswazibwa" (1 Peetero 2:6).

Kale jjukira, waliwo oluggi lumu lwokka, era bw’otoluyingiramu, oteekwa kuzikiririra mu bibi byo. Oluggi luli awo; naye okuggyako ng’oluyingiddemu, lukugasa ki? Kya bwetaavu ggwe okugondera ekiragiro ky’enjiri. Tewali kiyinza kukulokola bw’otowulira ddoboozi lya Yesu, n’okola ky’alagira mu mazima ddala. Okulowooza n’okumalirira tebijja kumala; oteekwa okukikola ddala; kubanga ojja kuba mulamu ddala eri Katonda bw’onookkiriza ddala kyokka. Nawulira ku mukwano gwange eyali yeegomba nnyo okuba ekkubo ery’okukyusa omuvubuka, omuntu omu n’amugamba nti, "Oyinza okugenda gy’ali, n’oyogera naye, naye tojja kumutwala wala; kubanga amanyi nnyo enteekateeka y’obulokozi." Kyali bwe kityo ddala; era kyeyava, mukwano gwaffe bwe yatandika okwogera n’omuvubuka, n’afuna okuddibwamu nti, "Nkwebaza nnyo, naye simanyi oba olina bingi by’oyinza okumbuulira, kubanga mbadde mmanyi okuva edda era nga nsiima enteekateeka y’obulokozi okuyita mu ssaddaaka ya Kristo eyafiirira mu kifo kyaffe." Woowe! Yali awummulidde mu nteekateeka, naye nga tannakkiriza Oyo Yennyini. Enteekateeka y’obulokozi erimu omukisa mungi, naye tesobola kutugasa kintu kyonna okuggyako nga tukkiriza ffe ffennyini Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini. Enteekateeka y’ennyumba ekubudaabuda etya bw’otayingira mu nnyumba yennyini? Omusajja ali mu kifaananyi kyaffe, atudde wabweru mu nkuba, tafuna kubudaabudibwa kungi okuva mu nteekateeka ezimwanjuluziddwa mu maaso ge. Enteekateeka y’engoye egasa ki bw’oba tolina wadde enziina ey’okwebikka? Tewawulirangako ku mukulu w’Abawalabu e Kayiro, eyali omulwadde ennyo, n’agenda eri omuminsani, omuminsani n’amugamba nti asobola okumuwandiikira eddagala? Yakikola; era oluvannyuma lwa wiiki emu n’asanga Omuwalabu nga tannatereera n’akatono. Wakozesezza bye nakuwandiikira?" bwe yamubuuza. "Weewaawo, nalidde buli katundu k’olupapula." Yaloota nti agenda kuwonyezebwa olw’okulya ebiwandiiko by’omusawo, bye nnyinza okuyita enteekateeka y’eddagala. Yandibadde atwala ebyawandiikibwa ne bimukolerwako eddagala, olwo ne liyinza okumugasa, singa yalinywa: tekyandimugasizza n’akatono okumira olupapula lw’eddagala. Bwe kiri bwe kityo n’obulokozi: si nteekateeka ya bulokozi eyinza okulokola, wabula kwe kutuukiriza enteekateeka eyo Mukama Yesu kwe yakola mu kufa kwe ku lwaffe, n’okukkiriza kwaffe ekyo. Wansi w’amateeka g’Abayudaaya, oyo eyawangayo ssaddaaka yaleetanga ente ennume, n’agiteekako emikono gye: tekyali kirooto, wadde endowooza, wadde enteekateeka. Mu nsolo ey’okuwaayo ssaddaaka yasangangamu ekintu ekyaddala, kye yasobolanga okukwata n’okukomako: era naffe bwe tutyo twesigama ku mulimu ogwa ddala era ogw’amazima ogwa Yesu, ekintu ekisinga obwa ddala wansi w’eggulu. Tujja eri Mukama Yesu olw’okukkiriza, ne tugamba nti, "Katonda ateeseteese okutangirira wano, era nkukkiriza. Nzikiriza ekyakolebwa ku musaalaba; nkakasa nti ekibi kyaggyibwawo Kristo, era nneesigama ku ye." Bw’oba oyagala okulokolebwa, oteekwa okusukka okukkiriza enteekateeka n’enjigiriza, n’otuuka ku kuwummulira mu Mukama Yesu Kristo yennyini ow’obwakatonda, ne mu mulimu gwe ogwaggwa. Musomi omwagalwa, onoosembeza Kristo kati? Yesu ayita bonna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa okujja gy’ali, era alibawummuza. Kino takisuubiza abo abamulootako obulootazi. Bateekwa okujja; era bateekwa okujja GY’ALI YE, so si mu Kkanisa bujja, oba mu kubatizibwa, oba mu kukkiriza okutuufu, oba eri ekintu kyonna ekitatuuka ku ye yennyini ow’obwakatonda. Omusota ogw’ekikomo bwe gwawanikibwa mu ddungu, abantu tebaalina kutunuulira Musa, wadde Eweema, wadde empagi ey’ekire, wabula omusota ogw’ekikomo gwennyini. Okutunula tekwamala okuggyako nga batunuulira ekintu ekituufu: era ekintu ekituufu tekyamala okuggyako nga batunuulidde. Tekyabamala kumanya bumanya ku musota ogw’ekikomo; buli omu yali ateekwa okugutunuulira ye kennyini. Omuntu bw’aba omulwadde, ayinza okuba ng’amanyi bulungi eby’eddagala, naye n’afa bw’atanywa ddala ddagala eriwonya. Tuteekwa okusembeza Yesu; kubanga "bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda." Teeka essira ku bigambo bibiri: Tuteekwa okusembeza YE, era tuteekwa OKUMUSEMBEZA ye. Tuteekwa okuggulawo ennyo oluggi, ne tuyingiza Kristo Yesu; kubanga "Kristo abeera mu mmwe" ye "essuubi ery’ekitiibwa." Kristo tateekwa kuba gye tuli lugero lwa bufuusa, wadde ekirooto, wadde ekisiikirize, wabula omuntu owa ddala, era Katonda ddala; era okumusembeza kwaffe tekuteekwa kuba kwa kukakibwa oba kwa bulimba, wabula okukkiriza n’okukkiriziganya okw’omutima gwonna era okw’essanyu okw’emmeeme nti ye anaaba byonna mu byonna eby’obulokozi bwaffe. Tetujja mangu ago kujja gy’ali, ne tumufuula obwesige bwaffe bwokka? Ejjiba liyiggibwa kamunye, era terifuna bukuumi okuva eri omulabe waalyo atawummula. Liyize nti waliwo obuddukiro bwalyo mu njatika y’olwazi, era lyanguwa okugendayo n’ebiwaawaatiro eby’essanyu. Bwe limala okwekweka ddala mu buddukiro bwalyo, teritya nnyonyi yonna eyiggana. Naye singa teryekweka mu lwazi, lyandikwatiddwa omulabe waalyo. Olwazi terwandigasizza jjiba, singa ejjiba teryayingira mu njatika yaalwo. Omubiri gwonna gulina okukwekebwa mu lwazi. Ne bwe zandibaddewo ennyonyi endala emitwalo kkumi ezaafuna ekigo awo, ekyo tekyandirokodde jjiba eryo limu kamunye ly’ayigga kati! Liteekwa okuteeka ddala bwonna bwalyo mu buddukiro, ne lyeziika mu kifo kyalyo eky’obuddukiro, oba obulamu bwalyo bunaatwalibwa omuzikiriza. Nga kino kifaananyi kya kukkiriza! Kwe kuyingira mu Yesu, okwekweka mu biwundu bye. "Lwazi lw’Emirembe, eyayatikira ku lwange, Ka nneekweke mu ggwe." Ejjiba terikyalabika: olwazi lwokka lwe lulabika. Bw’etyo emmeeme ey’omusango bw’efubutuka n’eyingira mu mbiriizi za Yesu ezaafumitibwa, olw’okukkiriza, n’eziikibwa mu ye, obwenkanya obuwoolera eggwanga ne butakyagiraba. Naye walina okubaawo okuddukira kuno okw’omuntu kennyini eri Yesu okufuna obuddukiro; era kino kye bangi kye bongezaayo buli lunaku, okutuusa lwe kitiibwa nti "balifiira mu bibi byabwe." Ekigambo ekyo nga kya ntiisa! Kye kyo Mukama waffe kye yagamba Abayudaaya abatakkiriza; era akigamba ffe mu kiseera kino kyennyini: "bwe mutakkiriza nti nze wuuyo, Omwana wa Katonda, mulifiira mu bibi byammwe." Kikankanya omutima gw’omuntu okulowooza nti ne bw’aba omu yekka anaasoma ennyiriri zino ayinza okuba mu kibiina eky’ennaku ekijja okuzikirira bwe kityo. Mukama akiziyize olw’ekisa kye ekinene! Ennaku ziri, nalaba ekifaananyi eky’ekitalo, kye nnaakozesa okulaga ekkubo ly’obulokozi olw’okukkiriza Yesu. Omusobya yali azizza omusango ogwali gumugwanira okufa, naye kyali mu biseera eby’edda, amakanisa bwe gaali gatwalibwa ng’ebifo eby’obuddukiro abamenyi b’amateeka mwe baasobolanga okwekweka, ne bawona okufa. Laba omusobya! Afubutuka ng’adda eri ekkanisa, abakuumi bamugoba n’ebitala byabwe nga babisowodde, nga balumwa ennyonta y’omusaayi gwe! Bamugoberera okutuuka ne ku mulyango gw’ekkanisa. Ayanguwa n’alinnya amadaala, era bwe baba banaatera okumutuukako, bamutemetemere ku mulyango gw’ekkanisa, Omulabirizi n’afuluma, n’ayimusa omusaalaba, n’akaaba nti, "Mudde emabega, mudde emabega! Temwonoona kifo kya nnyumba ya Katonda na musaayi! Mudde emabega!" Abaserikale abakambwe amangu ago ne bassaamu ekitiibwa akabonero ako, ne badda emabega, ate omubunyi omwavu ne yeekweka emabega w’ebyambalo by’Omulabirizi. Bwe kiri ne Kristo. Omwonoonyi ali mu musango adduka butereevu eri Yesu; era newankubadde Obwenkanya bumugoba, Kristo ayimusa emikono gye egyafumitibwa, n’akaabira Obwenkanya nti, "Dda emabega! Omwonoonyi ono mmuwa obuddukiro; mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’eweema yange mwe mmukweka; sijja kumuleka kuzikirira, kubanga yeesiga nze." Mwonoonyi, ddukira eri Kristo! Naye oddamu nti, "Ndi mubi nnyo." Gy’okoma okuba omubi, gy’ojja okukoma okumuwa ekitiibwa ng’okkiriza nti asobola okukuuma ne ggwe. "Naye ndi mwonoonyi munene nnyo." Kale ekitiibwa ekingi kijja kumuweebwa bw’onoobaako n’okukkiriza okumwesiga, newankubadde oli mwonoonyi munene. Bw’oba n’akalwadde akatono, n’ogamba omusawo wo nti—"Ssebo, nneesiga nnyo obukugu bwo okuwonya," tewali kitiibwa kinene mu kwogera kwo okwo. Buli muntu asobola okuwonya olunwe oluluma, oba akalwadde akatono. Naye bw’oba ng’oli mulwadde nnyo n’endwadde nnyingi ezikubonyaabonya ennyo, n’ogamba nti—"Ssebo, sinoonya musawo amusinga; sijja kubuuza magezi galala wabula ago go; nneewaayo gy’oli n’essanyu;" nga omuwadde ekitiibwa kinene, olw’okusobola okuteeka obulamu bwo mu mikono gye nga buli mu kabi akanene era ak’amangu! Kolera bw’otyo ne Kristo; teeka emmeeme yo mu mikono gye: kikole ng’omaliridde, era awatali kubuusabuusa. Weetantale okuleka amasuubi amalala gonna: weetantale ne byonna ku Yesu; ŋŋamba nti "weetantale" newankubadde mu mazima temuli kabi konna mu kyo, kubanga asobola nnyo okulokola. Weesuule ku Yesu bwesuuzi; mu mmeeme yo temubanga kirala kyonna eri Yesu wabula okukkiriza; mukkirize, era omwesige, era tolikwatibwa nsonyi n’akatono olw’obwesige bwo. "oyo eyeesiga Kristo, taliswazibwa" (1 Peetero 2:6).

fields.title: Okukkiriza Kwangu Nnyo.
fields.body_html:
Eri bangi, okukkiriza kulabika ng’ekintu ekizibu. Amazima gali nti, kuzibu lwa kuba kwangu. Naamani yalaba nga kizibu okugambibwa okunaaba mu Yoludaani; naye singa kyali kintu kinene, yandikikoze n’essanyu lingi. Abantu balowooza nti obulokozi buteekwa okuva mu kikolwa oba mu kuwulira okumu, okw’ekyama ennyo era okuzibu ennyo; naye ebirowoozo bya Katonda si birowoozo byaffe, n’amakubo ge si ge makubo gaffe. Abanafu ennyo n’abatamanyi ennyo basobole okulokolebwa, kyeyava afuula ekkubo ly’obulokozi okuba eryangu nga A, B, C. Tewali kirimu kisobera muntu yenna; wabula, olw’okuba buli muntu asuubira okusoberwa, bangi bawuniikirira bwe bazuula nti kyangu nnyo bwe kityo.

Amazima gali nti tetukkiriza nti Katonda ategeeza ky’ayogera; tweyisa ng’abalowooza nti tekiyinza kuba kya mazima.

Nnawulira ku musomesa w’essomero lya Ssande eyakola okugezesa kwe ndowooza nti sirikugezaako ku baana, kubanga kuyinza okumpeera ebbeeyi ennyo. Mazima ddala, nkakasa nti ekyandivuddemu gye ndi kyandibadde kya njawulo nnyo ku kye nnyumya kaakano. Omusomesa ono yali agezaako okunnyonnyola okukkiriza kye ki, era bwe yalemwa okukiyingiza mu mitwe gy’abalenzi be, n’aggyayo essaawa ye, n’agamba nti, "Kale, nkuwa essaawa eno, John. Onoogitwala?" John n’atandika okulowooza omusomesa ky’ategeeza, n’atakwata kirabo ekyo eky’omuwendo, era n’atayanukula. Omusomesa n’agamba omulenzi eyaddirira nti, "Henry, essaawa yiino. Onoogitwala?" Omulenzi, mu buwombeefu obusaanidde, n’addamu nti, "Nedda, weebale, ssebo." Omusomesa n’agezesa abalenzi abawerako, ne kiba bwe kityo; okutuusa ku nkomerero omuto omu, ataali wa magezi oba mulowooza nga banne, naye eyali akkiriza okusingawo, n’agamba mu ngeri ey’obulijjo ddala nti, "Weebale, ssebo," n’ateeka essaawa mu nsawo ye. Awo abalenzi abalala ne bazuukuka okutegeera ekintu ekyewuunyisa: munnaabwe yali afunye essaawa gye baagaanye. Omu ku balenzi n’abuuza amangu omusomesa nti, "Agenda kugisigaza?" "Ddala agenda kugisigaza," omusomesa bwe yagamba, "Nagimuwadde, n’agikkiriza. Siyinza kuwa kintu ate ne nkiggyako: ekyo kyandibadde busirusiru bwa maanyi. Nabateekera essaawa mu maaso, ne mbagamba nti mbagiwadde, naye tewali n’omu ku mmwe eyayagadde kugitwala." "Ayi!" omulenzi n’agamba, "singa nnamanya nti otegeeza, nandigitutte." Kya ddala yandigitutte. Yalowooza nti gwali muzannyo buzannyo, si kirala. Abalenzi abalala bonna ne banakuwala nnyo nga balowooza ku ssaawa gye bafiiriddwa. Buli omu n’akaaba nti, "Musomesa, saamanya nti otegeeza, naye nnalowooza—" Tewali yatwala kirabo; naye buli omu yalowooza. Buli omu yalina endowooza ye, okuggyako omulenzi omwangu eyakkiriza kye baamugamba, n’afuna essaawa. Kaakano nandyagadde bulijjo okuba omwana omwangu bw’atyo, okukkiriza ddala Mukama ky’ayogera nga bwe kiri, n’okutwala ky’anteeka mu maaso, nga mmatidde ddala nti tazannya nange, era nti siyinza kusobya bwe nkkiriza ky’anteekera mu maaso mu njiri. Twandibadde basanyufu singa twesiga, ne tutabuuza bibuuzo bya ngeri yonna. Naye, woowe! tusigala tulowooza era tubuusabuusa. Mukama bw’ayimusa Omwana we omwagalwa mu maaso g’omwonoonyi, omwonoonyi oyo yandimututte awatali kulonzalonza. Bw’omutwala, oba omufunye; era tewali ayinza kumukuggyako. Golola omukono gwo, munnange, omutwale mangu ddala!

Abanoonya bwe bakkiriza Bayibuli nti ya mazima nga bw’eri, ne balaba nti Yesu aweebwa ddala bonna abamwesiga, obuzibu bwonna obw’okutegeera ekkubo ly’obulokozi buggwaawo ng’omuzira gw’oku makya bwe gusaanuuka enjuba bw’evaayo.

Abanoonya babiri bajja gye ndi mu kisenge kyange eky’omu kkanisa. Baali bawulidde enjiri okuva gye ndi okumala akaseera katono kokka, naye yali ebakutte nnyo ku mitima. Ne banyumya ennaku yaabwe olw’okuba baali banaatera okusenguka okugenda ewala, naye ne bongerako okwebaza nti baali bampulidde n’akatono. Okwebaza kwabwe okw’ekisa kwanzizaamu amaanyi, naye ne neeraliikirira nti omulimu ogusingako amaanyi gwandibakoleddwamu, kyennava mbabuuza nti, "Mazima ddala mukkirizza Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo? Mulokoleddwa?" Omu ku bo n’addamu nti, "Mbadde ngezaako nnyo okukkiriza." Ebigambo bino mbiwulidde emirundi mingi, naye sijja kubireka kumpitako nga sibiwakanyizza. "Nedda," ne ŋŋamba, "ekyo tekimala. Wali ogambyeko kitaawo nti ogezaako okumukkiriza?" Bwe namala okwogera ku nsonga eyo akaseera, ne bakkiriza nti ebigambo ng’ebyo byandibadde kivume eri kitaabwe. Awo ne mbateekera enjiri mu maaso mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo, mu bigambo ebyangu nga bwe nnasobola, ne mbeegayirira bakkirize Yesu, asaanira okukkirizibwa okusinga taata asinga obulungi. Omu ku bo n’addamu nti, "Sisobola kukitegeera ddala: sisobola kukitegeera nti ndokoleddwa." Awo ne ngenda mu maaso ne ŋŋamba nti, "Katonda ajulira Omwana we, nti buli eyeesiga Omwana we alokoleddwa. Kaakano onoomufuula mulimba, oba onookkiriza ekigambo kye?" Bwe nnali njogera bwe ntyo, omu ku bo n’akankana ng’eyeewuunyizza, n’atwewuunyisa ffenna bwe yaleekaana nti, "Ayi ssebo, kaakano byonna mbiraba; ndokoleddwa! Ayi, tendereza Yesu ku lwange; andaze ekkubo, era andokodde! Byonna mbiraba." Mwannyinaffe ow’ekitiibwa eyali aleese abavubuka bano gye ndi n’afukamira nabo, ne tutendereza era ne tugulumiza Mukama n’emitima gyaffe gyonna olw’emmeeme ereeteddwa mu kitangaala. Naye omu ku bawala abo ababiri ab’oluganda teyasobola kulaba njiri nga munne bwe yagiraba, newankubadde nga nkakasa nti tegenda kulwa nga naye agiraba. Tekyalabika ng’ekyewuunyo nti, bombi nga bawulidde ebigambo bye bimu, omu n’avaayo n’ayingira mu kitangaala ekitangaavu, ate omulala n’asigala mu kizikiza? Enkyukakyuka egwa ku mutima okutegeera bwe kukwata enjiri etera okweyoleka ku maaso, n’eyakayaka awo ng’ekitangaala ky’eggulu. Emmeeme ng’ezo ezaakatangaazibwa zitera okuleekaana nti, "Ssebo, nga kyangu bwe kiti; kyandiba kitya nga sikirabanga okutuusa kaakano? Kaakano ntegeera byonna bye nnali nsomye mu Bayibuli, newankubadde nga nnali sisobola kubitegeera. Byonna bizze mu kaseera katono, era kaakano ndaba kye nnali sisobola kutegeera." Amazima gali nti amazima gaali matangaavu bulijjo, naye baali banoonya obubonero n’ebyewuunyo, kyebaava batalaba ekyali kumpi nabo. Abakadde batera okunoonya galubindi zaabwe nga ziri ku byenyi byabwe; era kitera okulabika nti tulemwa okulaba ekiri mu maaso gaffe ddala. Kristo Yesu ali mu maaso gaffe, era kye twetaaga kyokka kwe kumutunuulira, ne tuba balamu; naye tukifuula ekisobeza mu ngeri zonna, bwe tutyo ne tukola ekisoko ekizibu okuva mu kintu ekyangu ng’olunaku olw’omusana.

Akantu ako akatono ak’abawala ababiri ab’oluganda kanzijukiza akalala. Mukwano gwange omu ow’ekitiibwa ennyo yajja gye ndi ku makya ga Ssabbiiti emu oluvannyuma lw’okusinza, okunkwata mu ngalo, "kubanga," bwe yagamba, "nnaweza emyaka ataano ku lunaku lwe lumu nga ggwe. Nkufaanana mu kintu ekyo kimu, ssebo; naye mu bintu ebisinga obulungi ndi wa njawulo ddala naawe." Ne ŋŋamba nti, "Kale oteekwa okuba omukazi omulungi ennyo; kubanga mu bintu bingi nange nandyagadde okuba ow’enjawulo ku nze bwe ndi." "Nedda, nedda," bwe yagamba, "saategeeza kintu kya ngeri eyo: siri mutuufu n’akatono." "Ki!" ne ndeekaana, "tokkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu?" "Kale," bwe yagamba, ng’ajjudde ennyiike, "Nze, nze, nja kugezaako okumukkiriza." Ne mmukwata ku mukono, ne ŋŋamba nti, "Mmeeme yange omwagalwa, tojja kuŋŋamba nti ojja kugezaako okukkiriza Mukama wange Yesu! Sisobola kukkiriza bigambo ng’ebyo okuva gy’oli. Bitegeeza butakkiriza bwereere. Kiki YE ky’akoze kye wandyogeddeko bw’otyo? Wandiŋŋambye nze nti onoogezaako okukkiriza nze? Mmanyi nti tewandinnyoomye bw’otyo. Ondowooza okuba omusajja ow’amazima, era kyova onkkiriza amangu ago; era mazima toyinza kukolera Mukama wange Yesu kitono ku ekyo." Awo n’amaziga n’aleekaana nti, "Ayi, ssebo, nsabira!" Ne mmuddamu nti, "Siwulira nga nsobola kukola kintu kya ngeri eyo. Nnyinza kusaba ki Mukama Yesu okukolera omuntu atayagala kumwesiga? Sirina kye ndaba kya kusabira. Bw’onoomukkiriza, ojja kulokolebwa; era bw’otoomukkiriza, siyinza kumusaba kuyiiya kkubo ppya okumatiza obutakkiriza bwo." Awo n’addamu nti, "Nja kugezaako okukkiriza"; naye ne mmugamba n’obukakafu nti sigenda kukkiriza kugezaako kwe n’akatono; kubanga obubaka okuva eri Mukama tebwayogera ku "kugezaako," wabula bwagamba nti, "Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa." Ne mmunyweza ku mazima ago amakulu, nti "Oyo akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo"; n’ekyo ekigakontana eky’entiisa— "atakkiriza gumaze okumusinga kubanga takkiririza mu linnya ly’Omwana oyo omu yekka owa Katonda." fields.title: Okutya Okukkiriza.
fields.body_html:
Kino kibala kya kyewuunyo eky’obutonde bwaffe obulwadde—okutya okukkiriza. Naye nkisisinkanye emirundi mingi: emirundi mingi nnyo ne kiba nti nandyagadde obutaddamu kukiraba. Kifaanana obwetoowaze, era kigezaako okwefuula omutima gwennyini ogw’obuwombeefu, naye nga kintu kya malala ag’ensonyi: mazima ddala, kwe kwekulumbaza okwefuula ekitali. Singa abantu batya obutakkiriza, okutya okwo kwandibaddemu amagezi; naye okutya okwesiga Katonda waabwe, ku kigero ekisinga obulungi, busirusiru, era mazima ddala ngeri ya bukuusa ey’okugaana Mukama ekitiibwa ekimusaanidde olw’obwesigwa bwe n’amazima ge.

Obunyiikivu obwemalira ku kunoonya ensonga lwaki okukkiriza mu mbeera yaffe tekuyinza kulokola, nga tebuliimu mugaso! Tulina ekigambo kya Katonda ekikakasa nti, ku bikwata ku Yesu, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, ate ffe ne tunoonya ensonga lwaki ffe twandizikiridde singa twakkiriza. Singa omuntu yenna ampa ettaka, mazima sanditandise kubuuza bibuuzo ku bwannannyini bwalyo. Kugasa ki okuyiiya ensonga lwaki sisaanidde kubeera mu nnyumba yange, oba okubeera n’ekintu ekirala kyonna kye nneeyagaliramu? Mukama bw’aba amatidde okundokola olw’obulungi bw’Omwana we omwagalwa, mazima nange nnyinza okumatira okulokolebwa bwe ntyo. Bwe nkkiriza Katonda ku kigambo kye, obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye tebuli ku nze, wabula ku Katonda, eyakola ekisuubizo.

Naye otya nti oyinza obutaba omu ku abo ekisuubizo be kigendereddwamu. Totiisibwa kubuusabuusa okwo okutaliimu. Tewali mmeeme yali ejjidde Yesu mu ngeri enkyamu. Tewali ayinza kujja n’akatono okuggyako nga Kitaffe amuleese; era Yesu yagamba nti, "buli ajja gye ndi sirimugobera bweru." Tewali mmeeme ekwata ku Kristo mu ngeri ya bubbi; oyo amulina amulina ku bwa ddembe lya Katonda; kubanga Mukama okwewaayo ku lwaffe era gye tuli kwa bwereere nnyo, ne kiba nti buli mmeeme emutwala erina eddembe eriweereddwa olw’ekisa okukikola. Bw’onookwata ku Yesu ku lukugiro lw’ekyambalo kye, awatali lukusa, era ng’oli emabega we, amaanyi gajja kuva gy’ali gakutuukeko mazima ddala nga bwe yandikuyise erinnya lyo, n’akulagira okumwesiga. Leka okutya kwonna bw’oba weesiga Omulokozi. Mutwale era osanyukirwe. Akkiriza Yesu ali omu ku balonde ba Katonda.

Wagamba nti kyandibadde kintu kya ntiisa singa weesiga Yesu ate n’ozikirira? Kyandibadde bwe kityo. Naye olw’okuba oteekwa okuzikirira bw’otomwesiga, akabi ku kigero ekisinga obubi tekali kanene nnyo.

"Nnyinza kuzikirira buzikirizi bwe nnaagenda; Mmaliridde okugezaako; Kubanga bwe nnaasigala ewala, mmanyi Nti nteekwa okufa emirembe gyonna."

Ka tugambe nti oyimirira mu Kidiba ky’Okuggwaamu Essuubi emirembe gyonna; ekyo kinaakugasa ki? Mazima kyandibadde kirungi okufa ng’ofuba okutambula mu luguudo lwa Kabaka olugenda eri Ekibuga eky’omu Ggulu, okusinga okweyongera okubbira wansi mu bitosi ne mu bucaafu bw’ebirowoozo eby’ekizikiza eby’obuteesiga! Tolina ky’ofiirwa, kubanga buli kimu okifiiriddwa dda; noolwekyo weesimbe okifube, era guma okukkiriza okusaasira kwa Katonda gy’oli, ddala gy’oli.

Naye omu asinda nti, "Bwe nnaajja eri Kristo, n’angaana?" Kye nzizaamu kiri nti, "Mugezese." Weesuule ku Mukama Yesu, olabe obanga anaakugaana. Ojja kuba ggwe osooka gw’aggalidde oluggi lw’essuubi. Munnange, tosomoka lutindo olwo nga tonnalutuukako! Yesu bw’alikusuula ebweru, olwo nno wanaaba wakyaliwo ekiseera ekimala okuggwaamu essuubi; naye ekiseera ekyo tekirituuka. "Yesu akolagana n’abantu abalina ebibi": tannatandika n’akatono kubagoba.

Tewawulirangako ku musajja eyabula ekkubo ekiro kimu, n’atuuka ku mabbali g’akagwa, nga bwe yalowooza, era mu kutya kwe ne yeewulira ng’agwa okuva ku lwazi olwo? N’akwata ku muti omukadde, n’awanikiramu awo, ng’anywezezza ekiwanirizo kye ekinafu n’amaanyi ge gonna. Yali akakasa nti, bwe yandite, yandibetenteddwa ebitundutundu ku njazi ez’entiisa ezaali zimulindiridde wansi. Awo n’asigala awanise, entuuyo nga zimuli ku kyenyi, n’obulumi mu buli kitundu. N’atuuka ku mbeera ey’omusujja ogw’amaanyi n’okuzirika, era ku nkomerero emikono gye ne gitasobola kuddamu kuwanirira mubiri gwe. N’asumulula emikono! N’agwa okuva ku kiwanirizo kye! N’agwa—ng’ekigere kimu oba awo, n’agwa ku lubalama olugonvu olumezeeko obukuku, kwe yagalamira, nga tafunye kisago n’akatono, era ng’ali bulungi ddala okutuusa ku makya. Bwe batyo, mu kizikiza ky’obutamanya bwabwe, bangi balowooza nti okuzikirira okw’enkalakkalira kubalindiridde, bwe banaayatula ekibi kyabwe, ne baleka essuubi lyonna mu bo bennyini, ne beewaayo mu mikono gya Katonda. Batya okuleka essuubi lye beekwatako olw’obutamanya. Kwe kutya okutaliimu. Leka buli kimu ky’okutteko okuggyako Kristo, ogwe. Gwa, oleke okwesiga kwonna mu bikolwa byo, oba mu kusaba kwo, oba mu nneewulira yo. Gwa amangu ago! Gwa kaakano! Lujja kuba lugonvu era lwa bukuumi olubalama olunaakwaniriza. Yesu Kristo, mu kwagala kwe, mu maanyi g’omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo, mu butuukirivu bwe obutuukiridde, ajja kukuwa ekiwummulo n’emirembe amangu ago. Lekera awo okwesiga wekka. Gwa mu mikono gya Yesu. Kino kye kitundu ekikulu eky’okukkiriza—okuleka buli kiwanirizo ekirala, n’ogwa ku Kristo bugwi. Tewali nsonga ya kutya: obutamanya bwokka bwe buleeta okutya kwo eri ekyo ekinaaba obukuumi bwo obw’emirembe n’emirembe. Okufa kw’essuubi ery’omubiri bwe bulamu bw’okukkiriza, era obulamu bw’okukkiriza bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo. Leka obwennyini bwo bufe, Kristo alyoke abe mulamu mu ggwe.

Naye ekizibu kiri nti, eri ekikolwa ekimu eky’okukkiriza Yesu, tetusobola kuleetayo bantu. Bajja kukozesa obukodyo bwonna okusinga okumalawo n’okwesiga bo bennyini. Bawugula okukkiriza, ne batya okukkiriza ng’ekisolo eky’entiisa. Mmwe abakankana abatalina magezi, ani eyabaloga? Mutya ekyo ekyandibadde okufa kw’okutya kwammwe kwonna, n’entandikwa y’essanyu lyammwe. Lwaki mwagala okuzikirira olw’okwagala mu bukakanyavu amakubo amalala okusinga enteekateeka y’obulokozi Katonda gye yateekawo yennyini?

Woowe! waliwo emmeeme nnyingi, nnyingi ezigamba nti, "Tulagiddwa okwesiga Yesu, naye mu kifo ky’ekyo tujja kugendanga mu kusinza obutayosa." Genda mu kusinza okw’olukale awatali kubuusabuusa, naye si mu kifo ky’okukkiriza, oba kujja kufuuka okwesiga okutaliimu. Ekiragiro kiri nti, "Kkiriza obeere mulamu;" kola ekyo, ne bw’onookola ekirala kyonna. "Kale, nja kutandika okusoma ebitabo ebirungi; mpozzi nja kufuna ebirungi mu ngeri eyo." Soma ebitabo ebirungi awatali kubuusabuusa, naye ekyo si njiri: enjiri eri nti, "Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa." Ka tugambe omusawo alina omulwadde gw’ajjanjaba, n’amugamba nti, "Onaanaabanga ku makya; kijja kuyamba nnyo ku bulwadde bwo." Naye omusajja n’anywa ekikopo kya caayi ku makya mu kifo ky’okunaaba, n’agamba nti, "Ekyo kijja kugasa kye kimu, sibuusabuusa." Omusawo we agamba ki bw’abuuza nti—"Wagoberera ekiragiro kyange?" "Nedda, saakigoberera." "Kale, mazima tosuubira nti waliba ekirungi kyonna ekiriva mu kukyala kwange, kubanga tofaayo ku biragiro byange." Bwe tutyo ffe, mu bikolwa, tugamba Yesu Kristo, bwe tuba nga tukeberebwa mu mmeeme, nti, "Mukama, wandagira okukwesiga, naye nandyagadde okukola ekirala! Mukama, njagala okulumirizibwa okw’entiisa; njagala okunyeenyezebwa ku mumwa gwa ggeyeena; njagala okutiisibwa n’okunakuwazibwa!" Yee, oyagala buli kimu okuggyako Kristo ky’akuwandiikidde, kwe kuba nti omwesige bwesizi. Ka obe ng’owulira oba towulira, weesuule ku ye, ye alyoke akulokole, era ye yekka. "Naye totegeeza nti oyogera bubi ku kusaba, n’okusoma ebitabo ebirungi, n’ebirala?" Siyogera kigambo na kimu kibi ku bintu ebyo byonna, nga bwe sandyogedde bubi ku musajja okunywa ekikopo kya caayi, singa nze nnali omusawo gwe njogeddeko. Ka anywe caayi we; naye si bw’aba aginywa mu kifo ky’okunaaba kw’alagiddwa. Bwe kityo ka omuntu asabe: gy’akoma okusaba gye kikoma okuba ekirungi. Ka omuntu anoonye mu Byawandiikibwa; naye, jjukira nti, ebintu bino bwe biteekebwa mu kifo ky’okukkiriza okwangu mu Kristo, emmeeme ejja kuzikirira. Mwegendereze waleme kubaawo ku mmwe Mukama waffe gw’agamba nti, "Munoonya mu Byawandiikibwa kubanga mulowooza nti muyinza okubifuniramu obulamu obutaggwaawo. Naye temwagala kujja gye ndi mulyoke mufune obulamu obutaggwaawo."

Jjangu eri Yesu olw’okukkiriza, kubanga awatali ye ozikirira emirembe gyonna. Wali weetegerezzaako engeri omuti gwa paini gye gwekwata mu njazi ezirabika ng’ezitaguwa ttaka? Gusindika akakolo akatono mu buli lwatika akatono kwonna akaggulwawo; gukwata n’olwazi olwereere ng’enjala z’ekinyonyi ekinene; gunyweza, ne gwesiba ku ttaka n’ennanga kikumi. Ekifaananyi kyaffe ekitono kituufu ddala. Tutera okulaba emiti nga gisimbiddwa bulungi bwe gityo ku bitole by’enjazi ennyereere ebyesudde. Kaakano, omutima omwagalwa, kino ka kibe ekifaananyi kyo. Kwata Olwazi olw’Emirembe n’Emirembe. Mwekwateko n’akakolo k’okukkiriza okutono. Leka akakolo ako akatono kakule; era, mu kiseera kye kimu, sindika akalala okukwata Olwazi lwe lumu omulundi omulala. Kwata ku Yesu, era osigale ng’okutte ku Yesu. Kula mu ye. Zingiza ebikolo by’obutonde bwo, emiguwa gy’omutima gwo, ku ye. Wa bwereere gy’oli ng’enjazi bwe ziri eri omuti gwa paini: naawe weesibe ku ye nga paini bw’enywezeddwa ku mabbali g’olusozi.

fields.title: Obuzibu mu Kkubo ly’Okukkiriza.
fields.body_html:
Kiyinza okuba nti omusomi awulira obuzibu mu kukkiriza. Ka yeetegereze. Tetusobola kukkiriza olw’ekikolwa eky’amangu ago. Embeera y’ebirowoozo gye tuyita okukkiriza kiva mu bintu ebirala, ekiddirira embeera z’ebirowoozo ezimu ezaasooka. Tutuuka ku kukkiriza mpolampola. Wayinza okubaawo ekintu ng’okukkiriza okw’okulaba okusooka; naye ebiseera ebisinga tutuuka ku kukkiriza mu mitendera: tufuna okwagala okumanya, tufumiitiriza, tuwulira obujulizi, tumatizibwa, era bwe tutyo ne tutuusibwa ku kukkiriza. Kale, bwe mba njagala okukkiriza, naye olw’ensonga emu oba endala ne nzuula nti siyinza kutuuka ku kukkiriza, nnaakola ki? Nnaayimirira ng’ente etunuulira omulyango omuggya; oba nnaakozesa, ng’omuntu alina amagezi, amakubo agasaanidde? Bwe mba njagala okukkiriza ekintu kyonna, nnaakola ki? Tujja kuddamu okusinziira ku mateeka g’amagezi ag’obulijjo.

Singa bambuulira nti Sulutaani w’e Zanzibar musajja mulungi, era nga kibadde nsonga gye nfaako, sirowooza nti nandifunye buzibu bwonna mu kukikkiriza. Naye singa olw’ensonga emu nnalina okubuusabuusa ku kyo, ate nga njagala okukkiriza amawulire ago, nandikoze ntya? Sandinoonyezza mawulire gonna ge nsobola okufuna ku Mukulu oyo, ne ngezaako, nga nsoma empapula z’amawulire n’ebiwandiiko ebirala, okutuuka ku mazima? Ekisinga obulungi, singa yali mu nsi muno, n’akkiriza okunsisinkana, era nange ne nsobola okunyumya n’abakungu b’olubiri lwe, n’abatuuze b’ensi ye, nandiyambiddwa nnyo okutuuka ku kusalawo olw’okukozesa ensibuko z’amawulire ezo. Obujulizi obupimiddwa n’okumanya okufuniddwa bitutuusa ku kukkiriza. Kya mazima nti okukkiriza mu Yesu kirabo kya Katonda; naye ebiseera ebisinga akugaba ng’agoberera amateeka g’ebirowoozo, era kyetuva tugambibwa nti "okukkiriza kujja olw’okuwulira ekigambo kya Kristo." Bw’oba oyagala okukkiriza Yesu, wulira ebimufaako, soma ebimufaako, lowooza ku ye, manya ebimufaako, era bw’otyo ojja kuzuula okukkiriza nga kumera mu mutima gwo, ng’eŋŋaano bw’emera olw’obunnyogovu n’ebbugumu nga bikola ku nsigo eyasigibwa. Singa nnali njagala okwesiga omusawo omu, nandisabye obujulizi bw’abo be yawonya, nandyagadde okulaba ebbaluwa ezikakasa okumanya kwe mu mulimu gwe, era nandyagadde n’okuwulira ky’ayogera ku ndwadde ezimu enzibu. Mazima ddala, nandikoze ebisoboka okumanya, ndyoke nkkirize.

Fubanga nnyo okuwulira ebikwata ku Yesu. Emmeeme mu bikumi zituuka ku kukkiriza Yesu wansi w’obuweereza obumwolesa mu bulambulukufu era obutayosa. Batono abasigala nga tebakkiriza wansi w’omubuulizi ensonga ye enkulu gy’ali Kristo eyakomererwa. Towuliriza mubuulizi wa ngeri ndala yonna. Gyebali. Nnawulira ku omu eyasanga mu Bayibuli ye ey’oku kituuti olupapula oluliko ebigambo bino, "Ssebo, twagala kulaba Yesu." Genda mu kifo eky’okusinza okulaba Yesu; era bw’oba tosobola wadde okuwulira erinnya lye nga lyogerwako, weggyeyo ogende mu kifo ekirala gy’alowoozebwako ennyo, era nga kyekiva kisinga okuba nti abaayo.

Fubanga nnyo okusoma ebikwata ku Mukama Yesu. Ebitabo by’Ebyawandiikibwa ge malanga mw’aliira. Bayibuli ye ddirisa lye tuyinza okutunuuliramu ne tulaba Mukama waffe. Soma emirundi n’emirundi emboozi y’okubonaabona kwe n’okufa kwe n’obwegendereza obw’okutya Katonda, era tekirirwa Mukama n’aleeta okukkiriza mu kyama mu mmeeme yo. Omusaalaba gwa Kristo tegusasula kukkiriza kyokka, naye era gukuzaala. Abakkiriza bangi basobola okugamba nti—

"Bwe nkulaba, ng’olina ebiwundu, ng’onakuwala, Ng’omukka gukuweddemu, ku muti ogwakolimirwa, Amangu ago mpulira omutima gwange nga gukkiriza Nti wabonaabona bw’otyo ku lwange."

Okuwulira n’okusoma bwe biba nga tebimala, olwo mu bugenderevu teeka ebirowoozo byo ku mulimu okwekenneenya ensonga eyo, ogimalirize. Oba kkiriza, oba manya ensonga lwaki tokkiriza. Gyekenneenye okutuuka ku ntikko y’obusobozi bwo, osabe Katonda akuyambe okunoonyereza ennyo, n’okutuuka ku kusalawo okw’amazima mu ngeri emu oba endala. Lowooza ku Yesu bwe yali, era obanga obutonde bwa Ye Yennyini tebumusaanyiza kwesigibwa. Lowooza ku bye yakola, era obanga nabyo tebiteekwa kuba musingi mulungi gwa kwesiga. Mulowoozeeko ng’afa, ng’azuukira okuva mu bafu, ng’alinnya mu ggulu, era ng’abeera mulamu ennaku zonna okuwolereza aboonoonyi; olabe obanga kino tekimusaanyiza ggwe okumwesigamako. Awo mukaabirire, olabe obanga tanaakuwulira. Usher bwe yayagala okumanya obanga Rutherford ddala yali mutukuvu nga bwe baamwogerangako, yagenda ewuwe ng’omusabiriza, n’afuna aw’okusula, n’awulira omusajja wa Katonda ng’ayiwa omutima gwe mu maaso ga Mukama ekiro. Bw’oba oyagala okumanya Yesu, musemberere nga bw’osobola, ng’oyiga empisa ze, era ng’osaba okwagala kwe.

Ekiseera kyali nandyetaaze obujulizi okunkkirizisa Mukama Yesu; naye kaakano mmumanyi bulungi nnyo, olw’okumugezesa, ne kiba nti nandyetaaze obujulizi bungi nnyo okumbuusabuusisa. Kaakano kya butonde gye ndi okwesiga okusinga okubuusabuusa: buno bwe butonde obuggya nga buwangula; tekyali bwe kityo ku ntandikwa. Obuggya bw’okukkiriza, ku ntandikwa, nsibuko ya bunafu; naye ekikolwa ku kikolwa eky’okwesiga kifuula okukkiriza empisa. Obumanyirivu buwa okukkiriza obukakafu obw’amaanyi.

Sitawaanyizibwa kubuusabuusa, kubanga amazima ge nkkiriza gankoledde ekyamagero. Olw’ago nfunye era nkyalina obulamu obuggya, bwe nnali sibumanyi edda: era buno bwe bukakafu obusinga amaanyi. Ndi ng’omusajja omulungi ne mukazi we abaali bakuuma omunaala gw’ettaala okumala emyaka mingi. Omugenyi, eyajja okulaba omunaala ogwo, ng’atunuulira mu ddirisa ku mazzi amangi agatalina kkomo, n’abuuza omukazi omulungi nti, "Totya ekiro, kibuyaga bw’aba akunta, n’amayengo amanene ne gakuba okusukka ettaala? Totya nti omunaala guno, ne byonna ebirimu, bijja kutwalibwa? Nkakasa nti nze nandityedde okwesiga nga ndi mu munaala omufunda wakati mu mayengo amanene." Omukazi n’agamba nti endowooza eyo kaakano tekyamujjira. Yali amaze eyo ebbanga ddene nnyo ne kiba nti yawulira ng’ali bulungi ku lwazi olwo olw’omu ttale nga bwe yawuliranga bwe yali abeera ku lukalu. Ate bba, bwe yabuuzibwa obanga teyeeraliikiriranga empewo bwe yakuntanga ng’omuyaga ogw’amaanyi, n’addamu nti, "Yee, neeraliikirira okukuuma ettaala nga zirongooseddwa bulungi, n’ekitangaala nga kyaka, ekyombo kyonna kireme okumenyeka." Ku kweraliikirira obukuumi bw’omunaala, oba obukuumi bwe ye kennyini mu gwo, ebyo yali yabiyitako dda. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’omukkiriza akuze. Asobola okugamba mu buwombeefu nti, "mmanyi gwe nakkiriza, era nkakasa nti ayinza okukuuma ekyo kye namuteresa okutuusa olunaku luli." Okuva kati waleme kubaawo muntu yenna ankaluubiriza na kubuusabuusa n’ebibuuzo; nnina mu mmeeme yange obukakafu bw’amazima n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo, era sijja kukkiriza bya kwefuula magezi byammwe eby’obukujjukujju. Enjiri gye ndi ge mazima: mmatira okuzikirira singa si ya mazima. Emmeeme yange n’enkomerero yaayo ey’emirembe n’emirembe ngiteeka ku mazima g’enjiri, era mmanyi nti tewali kabi mu kyo. Kye nfaako kyokka kwe kukuuma ettaala nga zaaka, ndyoke ngase abalala. Ka Mukama ampe buwi amafuta agamala okuliisa ettaala yange, ndyoke nsobole okusuula akasana ku nnyanja ey’ekizikiza era ey’enkwe ey’obulamu, era ndimatira.

Kaakano, ggwe anoonya ateganyizibwa, bw’eba nga bwe kiri, nti omusumba wo, n’abalala bangi b’owesiga, bafunye emirembe egituukiridde n’ekiwummulo mu njiri, lwaki ggwe tobifuna? Omwoyo wa Mukama akugirwa? Ebigambo bye tebiba birungi eri abo abakola obulungi? Era naawe tonoogezesa maanyi gaabyo agalokola?

Enjiri ya mazima nnyo, kubanga Katonda ye Nnannyini yo. Gikkirize. Omulokozi asobola nnyo, kubanga Mwana wa Katonda. Mwesige. Omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo gwa maanyi nnyo. Gutunuulire okusonyiyibwa. Omutima gwe ogw’ekisa gwagala nnyo. Gwanguyirire kaakano.

Bwe ntyo bwe nandikubirizza omusomi okunoonya okukkiriza; naye bw’aba tayagala, kiki ekirala kye nsobola okukola? Ntuusizza embalaasi ku mazzi, naye siyinza kugiwaliriza kunywa. Wabula, kino kijjukirwe—obutakkiriza bwa bugenderevu ng’obujulizi buteekeddwa mu kkubo ly’omuntu, n’agaana okubwekenneenya n’obwegendereza. Oyo atayagala kumanya, n’okukkiriza amazima, ye yekka gw’alina okunenya bw’afa ng’alina obulimba mu mukono gwe ogwa ddyo. Kya mazima nti "abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa": kya mazima kyenkanyi nti "abatakkiriza balisalirwa omusango ne gubasinga."
