Enjiri gye ndi ge mazima: mmatira okuzikirira singa si ya mazima. Emmeeme yange n’enkomerero yaayo ey’emirembe n’emirembe ngiteeka ku mazima g’enjiri, era mmanyi nti tewali kabi mu kyo. Kye nfaako kyokka kwe kukuuma ettaala nga zaaka, ndyoke ngase abalala. Ka Mukama ampe buwi amafuta agamala okuliisa ettaala yange, ndyoke nsobole okusuula akasana ku nnyanja ey’ekizikiza era ey’enkwe ey’obulamu, era ndimatira. Kaakano, ggwe anoonya ateganyizibwa, bw’eba nga bwe kiri, nti omusumba wo, n’abalala bangi b’owesiga, bafunye emirembe egituukiridde n’ekiwummulo mu njiri, lwaki ggwe tobifuna? Omwoyo wa Mukama akugirwa? Ebigambo bye tebiba birungi eri abo abakola obulungi? Era naawe tonoogezesa maanyi gaabyo agalokola? Enjiri ya mazima nnyo, kubanga Katonda ye Nnannyini yo. Gikkirize. Omulokozi asobola nnyo, kubanga Mwana wa Katonda. Mwesige. Omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo gwa maanyi nnyo. Gutunuulire okusonyiyibwa. Omutima gwe ogw’ekisa gwagala nnyo. Gwanguyirire kaakano. Bwe ntyo bwe nandikubirizza omusomi okunoonya okukkiriza; naye bw’aba tayagala, kiki ekirala kye nsobola okukola? Ntuusizza embalaasi ku mazzi, naye siyinza kugiwaliriza kunywa. Wabula, kino kijjukirwe—obutakkiriza bwa bugenderevu ng’obujulizi buteekeddwa mu kkubo ly’omuntu, n’agaana okubwekenneenya n’obwegendereza. Oyo atayagala kumanya, n’okukkiriza amazima, ye yekka gw’alina okunenya bw’afa ng’alina obulimba mu mukono gwe ogwa ddyo. Kya mazima nti "abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa": kya mazima kyenkanyi nti "abatakkiriza balisalirwa omusango ne gubasinga."

fields.title: Okwetegereza Okuyamba.
fields.body_html:
Okuyamba omunoonyi okutuuka ku kukkiriza okwa nnamaddala mu Yesu, njagala okumujjukiza omulimu Mukama Yesu gwe yakola mu kifo ky’aboonoonyi, ng’abadda mu bigere byabwe. "Bwe twali tukyali banafu wakati mu bibi, Kristo yatufiirira ffe aboonoonyi" (Abaruumi 5:6). "Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba" (1 Peetero 2:24). "Mukama n’amuteekako obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna" (Isaaya 53:6). "Kubanga ddala Kristo yabonyaabonyezebwa olw’ebibi omulundi gumu, Omuntu Omutuukirivu ku lw’abatali batuukirivu, alyoke abaleete eri Katonda" (1 Peetero 3:18).

Omusomi atunuulire nnyo ekigambo kimu ekya Ekyawandiikibwa: "Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya" (Isaaya 53:5). Wano Katonda ekibi akitwala ng’endwadde, era atuteekera mu maaso eddagala ery’omuwendo omungi lye yateekateeka.

Nkusaba n’obwegendereza bungi ontambuleko mu birowoozo byo, okumala eddakiika ntono, nga nkuleetera mu maaso ebiwundu bya Mukama Yesu. Mukama yamalirira okutuzzaawo, n’olwekyo n’atuma Omwana we omu yekka, "Katonda ddala ava mu Katonda ddala," akke mu nsi muno yeetwalire obuntu bwaffe, alyoke atununule. Yabeera muntu mu bantu; era ekiseera bwe kyatuuka, oluvannyuma lw’emyaka amakumi asatu oba okusingawo ng’agondera Kitaffe, ne wajja ekiseera atukolere omulimu ogusinga yonna obukulu, kwe kugamba, okuyimirira mu kifo kyaffe, n’okwetikka "ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe." Yagenda e Gesusemane, era eyo, bwe yalega ku kikopo kyaffe ekikaawa omulundi ogusooka, entuuyo ze ne zifuuka ng’amatondo amanene ag’omusaayi. Yagenda mu kisenge kya Piraato ne ku ntebe y’omusango eya Kerode, era eyo n’anywa ku bulumi ne ku kunyoomebwa mu kifo kyaffe. Ku nkomerero baamutwala ku musaalaba, ne bamukomereramu afiire awo—afiire mu kifo kyaffe. Ekigambo "ebiwundu" kikozesebwa okulaga okubonaabona kwe, okw’omubiri n’okw’emmeeme. Kristo yenna yafuulibwa ssaddaaka ku lwaffe: obuntu bwe bwonna bwabonaabona. Ku bikwata ku mubiri gwe, gwagabana n’omutima gwe mu nnaku etayinza kunnyonnyolwa. Okubonaabona kwe we kwatandikira, bwe yali abonaabona mu kifo kyaffe mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ennyo, yali mu bulumi bungi, era entuuyo ez’omusaayi ne zimuva mu mubiri nnyingi nnyo okutuusa lwe zaatonnya ku ttaka. Kibaawo lumu na lumu nnyo omuntu okutuuyana omusaayi. Waliwo abantu omu oba babiri kye kyabaddako, era ne bafa kumpi amangu ago; naye Omulokozi waffe yabeera mulamu—yabeera mulamu oluvannyuma lw’obulumi obwandisse omuntu omulala yenna. Nga tannaba na kwerongoosa mu maaso okuggyako omusaayi ogwo ogw’entiisa, baamwanguyiza mu kisenge kya kabona asinga obukulu. Mu ttumbi baamusiba, ne bamutwala. Oluvannyuma ne bamutwala eri Piraato n’eri Kerode. Bano baamukuba embooko, n’abaserikale baabwe ne bamuwandira amalusu mu maaso, ne bamukuba ebikonde, ne bamutikkira engule ey’amaggwa. Okukubibwa embooko kye kimu ku bibonyoobonyo ebisinga obubi ettima bye liyinza okuleeta. Edda kyali kivume eri eggye lya Bungereza nti "ekkato" lyakozesebwanga ku muserikale: okubonyaabonya okw’obukambwe. Naye Omuruumi obukambwe bwali bumwanguyira nnyo, n’afuula ebibonerezo bye ebya bulijjo okusinga n’obw’ensolo. Kigambibwa nti embooko y’Abaruumi yakolebwanga mu misuwa gy’ente, nga girangiddwa ne bisibibwamu amafundo, era mu mafundo ago ne mubaamu obubajjo bw’amagumba n’obugumba bw’endiga; buli lwe yagwanga ku mugongo ogwereere, "nga kwe bayisizza ekyuma ekirima." Omulokozi waffe yali alina okugumiikiriza obulumi obw’amaanyi obw’embooko y’Abaruumi, era kino tekyali nkomerero ya kibonerezo kye, wabula ng’entandikwa y’okukomererwa. Ku ekyo abaamuyigganya ne bongerako okumukuba ebikonde n’okumukuunyuula enviiri: tebaamutaliza bulumi bwa ngeri yonna. Newaakubadde yali ayongobedde olw’okuvaamu omusaayi n’enjala, baamwetikka omusaalaba gwe okutuusa omuntu omulala lwe yawalirizibwa, olw’obukambwe bwabwe obwalowooza nga bukyali, okugwetikka, sikulwa ng’oyo gwe baali babonyaabonya afiira mu kkubo. Baamwambula, ne bamusuula wansi, ne bamukomerera ku muti. Baafumita emikono gye n’ebigere bye. Baasitula omuti nga ali ku gwo, ne bagukasuka mu kinnya kyagwo mu ttaka, ebitundu bye byonna ne biva mu nnyingo, nga bwe kyakaabirwa mu zabbuli ey’amakumi abiri mu bbiri: "Ngiyiddwa ng’amazzi, n’amagumba gange gasowose mu nnyingo zaago." Yawanikibwa mu musana ogwokya okutuusa omusujja lwe gwamumalamu amaanyi, n’agamba nti, "Omutima gwange guli ng’obubaane, era gusaanuukidde mu mubiri gwange. Amaanyi gampweddemu, gakaze ng’oluggyo; n’olulimi lwange lukutte waggulu mu kibuno kyange. Ondese awo mu nfuufu ng’omufu." Eyo gye yawanikibwa, ng’ekyerolerwa eri Katonda n’abantu. Obuzito bw’omubiri gwe bwasooka kuwaniriddwa bigere bye, okutuusa emisumaali lwe gyayuza obusimu obugonvu: olwo omugugu ogwo ogw’obulumi ne gutandika okusika emikono gye, ne guyuza ebitundu ebyo ebiwulira ennyo eby’omubiri gwe. Ekiwundu ekitono ennyo mu ngalo kireetedde abantu endwadde esiba akamwa! Ate obulumi obwaleetebwa ekyuma ekyo ekisika nga kiyuza ebitundu ebigonvu eby’emikono n’ebigere bwali bwa ntiisa yenkana wa! Kaakano obulumi bwonna obw’omubiri bwali bukuŋŋaanidde mu mubiri gwe ogwali gubonyaabonyezebwa. Mu kiseera ekyo kyonna abalabe be baali bayimiridde okumwetooloola, nga bamusongamu engalo nga bamunyooma, nga bamwolekeza ennimi okumusekerera, nga basaaga ku kusaba kwe, era nga basanyukira okubonaabona kwe. Yaleekaana nti, "Ennyonta ennuma," ne bamuwa omwenge omukaatuufu ogutabuddwamu omususa. Oluvannyuma lw’akaseera n’agamba nti, "Kiwedde." Yali agumiikirizza ennaku yonna eyali emuteekeddwawo, era yali amalirizza okusasula obwenkanya bwa Katonda mu bujjuvu: awo, so si nga tekinnabaawo, n’awaayo obulamu bwe. Abantu abatukuvu ab’edda baayogera nnyo era n’okwagala kungi ku kubonaabona kw’omubiri kwa Mukama waffe, era nange sitya kukola kye kimu, nga nsuubira nti aboonoonyi abakankana bajja kulaba obulokozi mu "biwundu" bino ebirumya eby’Omununuzi.

Okunnyonnyola okubonaabona kwa Mukama waffe okw’okungulu si kyangu: nzikiriza nti nnemereddwa. Naye okubonaabona kw’emmeeme ye, okwali omutima gw’okubonaabona kwe kwonna, ani ayinza n’okukulowooza, ng’okwogera ku kwo kwe kusinga obuzibu? Ku ntandikwa ddala nakugambye nti entuuyo ze zaali ng’amatondo amanene ag’omusaayi. Ogwo gwali mutima gwe nga gusindika obulamu bwe ebweru olw’ennaku ey’entiisa eyali emunyigiriza mu mwoyo. Yagamba nti, "Omwoyo gwange guliko ennaku egenda na kunzita." Okulyamu olukwe kwa Yuda, n’okumwabulira kw’abayigirizwa ekkumi n’ababiri, byanakuwaza Mukama waffe; naye obuzito bw’ekibi kyaffe bwe bwali bumunyigiriza ddala ku mutima. Omusango gwaffe gwe gwali ekinyigiriza amafuta ekyamukamula amazzi g’obulamu bwe. Tewali lulimi luyinza kwogera ku bulumi bwe yalina ng’alindirira okubonaabona kwe; kale tuyinza kulowooza tutya ku kubonaabona kwennyini? Bwe yakomererwa ku musaalaba, yagumiikiriza ekyo omujulizi yenna ky’atabonyeeko; kubanga abajulizi, bwe baafa, Katonda yabawanirira nnyo ne basanyuka wakati mu bulumi bwabwe; naye Omununuzi waffe Kitaawe yamwabulira, okutuusa lwe yaleekaana nti, "Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?" Okwo kwe kwali okukaaba okusinga obukaawu, obuziba obusembayo obw’ennaku ye etategeerekeka. Naye kyali kyetaagisa okwabulirwa, kubanga Katonda wa kukyusa mugongo ku kibi, n’olwekyo ne ku oyo eyafuulibwa ekibi ku lwaffe. Emmeeme y’Oyo omukulu eyadda mu kifo kyaffe yabonaabona ekikangabwa ky’ennaku mu kifo ky’ekikangabwa ky’omuliro aboonoonyi mwe bandisuuliddwa singa teyeetikka kibi kyabwe, n’afuulibwa ekikolimo ku lwabwe. Kyawandiikibwa nti, "Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti;" naye ani amanyi ekikolimo ekyo kye kitegeeza?

Eddagala ly’ebibi byo n’ebyange lisangibwa mu kubonaabona kwa Mukama Yesu kwe yabonaabona mu kifo kyaffe, era mu ekyo kyokka. "Ebiwundu" bino ebya Mukama Yesu Kristo byali ku lwaffe. Obuuza nti, "Waliwo kye tulina okukola, okuggyawo omusango gw’ekibi?" Nkuddamu nti: Tewali kintu na kimu ky’olina kukola. Ebiwundu bya Yesu bye bituwonya. Ebiwundu ebyo byonna yabigumiikiriza, era teyatulekera na kimu ku byo okwetikka.

"Naye tetuteekwa kumukkiriza?" Weewaawo, ddala. Bwe njogera ku kizigo ekimu nti kiwonya, sigaana nti weetaaga ekiwero okukisiiga ku kiwundu. Okukkiriza kye kiwero ekisiba kalifuuwa ey’okutabaganya kwa Kristo ku kiwundu ky’ekibi kyaffe. Ekiwero tekiwonya; ogwo mulimu gwa kizigo. Bwe kityo okukkiriza tekuwonya; ogwo mulimu gwa kutangirira kwa Kristo.

"Naye tuteekwa okwenenya," omulala bw’aleekaana. Ddala tuteekwa, era tujja kwenenya, kubanga okwenenya kye kabonero akasooka ak’okuwona; naye ebiwundu bya Yesu bye bituwonya, so si okwenenya kwaffe. Ebiwundu bino, bwe biteekebwa ku mutima, bireeta okwenenya mu ffe: tukyawa ekibi kubanga kye kyaleetera Yesu okubonaabona.

Bw’oteeka obwesige bwo mu Yesu ng’otegeera bulungi nti yakubonaabonera, olwo ozuula nti Katonda talikubonereza olw’ekyonoono kye kimu Yesu kye yafiirira. Obwenkanya bwe tebumukkiriza kulaba ebbanja nga lisasulwa, okusooka, Omweyimirizi, n’oluvannyuma ate nga lisasulwa eyeewola. Obwenkanya tebuyinza kusaba kusasulwa mirundi ebiri: oba Omweyimirizi wange ayiwa omusaayi yeetisse omusango gwange, kale nze siyinza kuguyetikka. Bwe nkkiriza Kristo Yesu ng’abonaabona ku lwange, nkkirizza okusumululwa ddala okuva mu buvunaanyizibwa bwonna mu mbuga y’omusango. Nasalirwa omusango mu Kristo, era n’olwekyo kaakano sikyalina kusalirwa musango nate. Guno gwe musingi gw’obukuumi bw’omwonoonyi akkiriza Yesu: mulamu kubanga Yesu yafiira mu kifo kye, ng’adda mu bigere bye; era akkirizibwa mu maaso ga Katonda kubanga Yesu akkirizibwa. Omuntu Yesu gw’azze mu kifo kye ng’akkiriziddwa ateekwa okuta; tewali ayinza kumukwatako; taliiko musango. Ggwe ampulira, onookkiriza Yesu Kristo abeere mu kifo kyo? Bw’oba okkiriza, oli wa ddembe. "Amukkiriza tasalibwa musango." Bwe kityo "Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya."

Yagamba nti, "Omwoyo gwange guliko ennaku egenda na kunzita." Okulyamu olukwe kwa Yuda, n’okumwabulira kw’abayigirizwa ekkumi n’ababiri, byanakuwaza Mukama waffe; naye obuzito bw’ekibi kyaffe bwe bwali bumunyigiriza ddala ku mutima. Omusango gwaffe gwe gwali ekinyigiriza amafuta ekyamukamula amazzi g’obulamu bwe. Tewali lulimi luyinza kwogera ku bulumi bwe yalina ng’alindirira okubonaabona kwe; kale tuyinza kulowooza tutya ku kubonaabona kwennyini? Bwe yakomererwa ku musaalaba, yagumiikiriza ekyo omujulizi yenna ky’atabonyeeko; kubanga abajulizi, bwe baafa, Katonda yabawanirira nnyo ne basanyuka wakati mu bulumi bwabwe; naye Omununuzi waffe Kitaawe yamwabulira, okutuusa lwe yaleekaana nti, "Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?" Okwo kwe kwali okukaaba okusinga obukaawu, obuziba obusembayo obw’ennaku ye etategeerekeka. Naye kyali kyetaagisa okwabulirwa, kubanga Katonda wa kukyusa mugongo ku kibi, n’olwekyo ne ku oyo eyafuulibwa ekibi ku lwaffe. Emmeeme y’Oyo omukulu eyadda mu kifo kyaffe yabonaabona ekikangabwa ky’ennaku mu kifo ky’ekikangabwa ky’omuliro aboonoonyi mwe bandisuuliddwa singa teyeetikka kibi kyabwe, n’afuulibwa ekikolimo ku lwabwe. Kyawandiikibwa nti, "Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti;" naye ani amanyi ekikolimo ekyo kye kitegeeza? Eddagala ly’ebibi byo n’ebyange lisangibwa mu kubonaabona kwa Mukama Yesu kwe yabonaabona mu kifo kyaffe, era mu ekyo kyokka. "Ebiwundu" bino ebya Mukama Yesu Kristo byali ku lwaffe. Bw’oteeka obwesige bwo mu Yesu ng’otegeera bulungi nti yakubonaabonera, olwo ozuula nti Katonda talikubonereza olw’ekyonoono kye kimu Yesu kye yafiirira. Obwenkanya bwe tebumukkiriza kulaba ebbanja nga lisasulwa, okusooka, Omweyimirizi, n’oluvannyuma ate nga lisasulwa eyeewola. Obwenkanya tebuyinza kusaba kusasulwa mirundi ebiri: oba Omweyimirizi wange ayiwa omusaayi yeetisse omusango gwange, kale nze siyinza kuguyetikka. Bwe nkkiriza Kristo Yesu ng’abonaabona ku lwange, nkkirizza okusumululwa ddala okuva mu buvunaanyizibwa bwonna mu mbuga y’omusango. Nasalirwa omusango mu Kristo, era n’olwekyo kaakano sikyalina kusalirwa musango nate. Guno gwe musingi gw’obukuumi bw’omwonoonyi akkiriza Yesu: mulamu kubanga Yesu yafiira mu kifo kye, ng’adda mu bigere bye; era akkirizibwa mu maaso ga Katonda kubanga Yesu akkirizibwa. Omuntu Yesu gw’azze mu kifo kye ng’akkiriziddwa ateekwa okuta; tewali ayinza kumukwatako; taliiko musango. Ggwe ampulira, onookkiriza Yesu Kristo abeere mu kifo kyo? Bw’oba okkiriza, oli wa ddembe. "Amukkiriza tasalibwa musango." Bwe kityo "Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya."

fields.title: Ekiziyiza Ekya Nnamaddala.
fields.body_html:
Newaakubadde nga mu bwakyo si kizibu n’akatono okukkiriza oyo atayinza kulimba, n’okwesiga Oyo gwe tumanyi nti ayinza okulokola, kyokka wayinza okubaawo ekintu ekiyingira wakati ne kifuula ne kino ekizibu eri omusomi wange. Ekiziyiza ekyo kiyinza okuba eky’ekyama, naye ne kiba nga kiriwo ddala. Oluggi luyinza okuggalwa, si lwa jjinja ddene buli muntu ly’alaba, wabula lwa kisiba ekitalabika ekiyingira mu kakondo akakwekeddwa ddala. Omuntu ayinza okuba n’amaaso amalungi, naye n’atasobola kulaba kintu, kubanga ekintu ekirala kiyingidde wakati. Tewandisobodde na kulaba njuba singa ekitambaala, oba akagoye obugoye, kasibiddwa ku maaso go. Woowe, ebitambaala abantu bye beerumiriza okwesiba ku maaso gaabwe!

Ekibi ekiwoomerera, ekikuumirwa mu mutima, kijja kulemesa emmeeme okunywerera ku Kristo olw’okukkiriza. Mukama Yesu yajja okutulokola okuva mu kwonoona; era bwe tuba tumaliridde okugenda mu maaso n’okwonoona, Kristo n’emmeeme zaffe tebiriyinza kukkiriziganya. Omuntu bw’anywa obutwa, omusawo n’ayitibwa okuwonya obulamu bwe, ayinza okuba n’eddagala ery’ensonga erigoba obutwa; naye omulwadde bw’agugubira okukuuma eccupa y’obutwa ku mimwa gye, n’agenda mu maaso n’okumira amatondo agatta, omusawo ayinza atya okumuwonya? Obulokozi kwe kuyawula omwonoonyi ku kibi kye mu bungi bwakwo, era obulokozi engeri yaabwe yennyini yandibadde ekyusibwa nga tetunnaba kwogera nti omuntu alokoleddwa ng’akyayagala ekibi, era ng’akibeeramu mu bugenderevu. Omuntu tayinza kufuulibwa mweru n’agenda mu maaso nga muddugavu; tayinza kuwonyezebwa n’asigala nga mulwadde; era tewali ayinza kulokolebwa ate n’akyali muntu ayagala obubi.

Omutamiivu ajja kulokolebwa olw’okukkiriza Kristo—kwe kugamba, ajja kulokolebwa okuva mu kuba omutamiivu; naye bw’amalirira okweyongera okutamiira, tabeera alokoleddwa okuva mu kyo, era tabeera akkirizza Yesu mu mazima. Omulimba ayinza okulokolebwa okuva mu bulimba olw’okukkiriza, naye olwo alekayo okulimba, n’afaayo okwogera amazima. Buli muntu, ne bw’atunula katono, alaba nti tayinza kulokolebwa okuva mu kuba omulimba, ate n’agenda mu maaso mu mpisa ze ez’edda ez’obukuusa n’obulimba. Omuntu alina obulabe n’omulala ajja kulokolebwa okuva mu kuwulira obulabe obwo olw’okukkiriza Mukama Yesu; naye bw’alayira nti ajja kweyongera okukuuma obukyayi, kyeyoleka nti tannalokolebwa okuva mu bwo, era kyeyoleka bwe kityo nti tannakkiriza Mukama Yesu okutuuka ku bulokozi. Ensonga enkulu kwe kununulwa okuva mu kwagala ekibi: ekyo kye kiva mu kwesiga Omulokozi awatali kubuusabuusa; naye ekyo bwe kiba nga tekyagalibwa n’akatono, ne kigaanibwa n’okugaanibwa, ebigambo byonna eby’okwesiga Omulokozi okulokolebwa lugero lwa bwereere. Omuntu agenda mu ofiisi y’emmeeri, n’abuuza oba ayinza okutwalibwa e Amerika. Bamukakasa nti waliwo emmeeri eneetera okusimbula, era nti alina kulinnya bulinnya, mangu ddala ajja kutuuka e New York. "Naye," bw’agamba, "njagala kusigala waka mu Bungereza, nkuume edduuka lyange ekiseera kyonna nga nsala Atlantika." Omukozi oyo alowooza nti ayogera n’omulalu, n’amugamba agende akole ebibye, alekere awo okwonoona obudde bwe ng’akola eby’obusiru. Okwefuula nti weesiga Kristo okukulokola okuva mu kibi ng’ate okyamaliridde okukibeeramu, kuba kuduulira Kristo. Nsaba omusomi wange obutagwa mu kuvvoola okw’engeri eyo. Aleme kulowooza nti Yesu omutukuvu ajja kuba muwolereza w’obutali butuukirivu.

Olaba omuti ogwo mu kifaananyi kyange? Ekiranda kigumeze kyonna, era kigutuga, nga kigunuunamu obulamu bwagwo, era nga kigutta. Omuti ogwo guyinza okulokolebwa? Omulimi w’ennimiro alowooza nti guyinza. Mwetegefu okukola kyonna ky’asobola. Naye nga tannatandika kukozesa mbazzi ye n’akambe ke, bamugamba nti tateekwa kusalako kiranda. "Aa! kale," bw’agamba, "tekisoboka. Ekiranda kye kitta omuti, era bw’oba oyagala omuti gulokolebwe, toyinza kulokola kiranda. Bw’oba onneesiga okukuuma omuti, oteekwa okundeka ne nguggyako ekiranda ekyo ekitta." Ekyo si kya magezi ga bulijjo? Ddala kye kyo. Omuti toguwa mulimi wa nnimiro okuggyako ng’omwesiga okusalako ekyo ekigutta. Omwonoonyi bw’anaakuuma ekibi kye, ateekwa okufiira mu kyo; bw’aba ayagala okununulwa okuva mu kibi kye, Mukama Yesu asobola okukikola, era ajja kukikola bw’anaamukwasa ensonga ye.

Kale ekibi kyo ky’oyagala ennyo kye kiruwa? Kibi kya kuswaza ekyeyolefu? Kale ensonyi zokka zandikuleetedde okukireka. Kwe kwagala ensi, oba okutya abantu, oba okwegomba amagoba amabi? Ddala, tewali na kimu ku bino ekyandikuleetedde okukkiriza okubeera omulabe wa Katonda, ng’akusunguwalidde. Kwagala kwa muntu, okulya omutima ng’obusagwa bw’ekiwundu? Waliwo ekitonde kyonna ekiyinza okuvuganya ne Mukama Yesu? Si kusinza bifaananyi okukkiriza ekintu kyonna eky’oku nsi okugeraageranyizibwa ne Mukama Katonda ne bwe kiba kaseera katono? "Kale," omu bw’agamba, "nze okuleka ekibi ekyo kyennyini ekinsibye mu busibe, kyandimpisizza bubi nnyo mu bya bizineesi, kyandisaanyaawo essuubi lyange, era ne kikendeeza ku mugaso gwange mu ngeri nnyingi." Bwe kiba bwe kityo, ensonga yo eddibwamu ebigambo bya Mukama Yesu, akulagira okuggyamu eriiso lyo, n’okutemako omukono gwo oba ekigere kyo, okisuule wala, okusinga okusuulibwa mu ggeyeena. Kirungi okuyingira mu bulamu ng’olina eriiso limu, n’essuubi erisinga obutono, okusinga okukuuma essuubi lyo lyonna ng’oli bweru wa Kristo. Okuba omukkiriza awenyera kisinga okuba omwonoonyi abuuka. Okuba mu lunyiriri olw’emabega obulamu bwo bwonna mu ggye lya Kristo kisinga okukulembera eggye n’oba omukulu w’abaserikale wansi w’obuyinza bwa Setaani. Bw’onoofuna Kristo, ky’onoofiirwa kinaaba tekikyali kikulu. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti bangi kibadde kibagwanira okubonaabona olw’ebyo ebibalemazza mu bulamu buno; naye bwe baba bayingidde bwe batyo mu bulamu obutaggwaawo, bafunye nnyo.

Kituuse wano, mukwano gwange, nga bwe kyali eri John Bunyan; eddoboozi kaakano lyogera naawe, ne ligamba nti—

ONOOKUUMA EKIBI KYO N’OGENDA MU GGEYEENA?

OBA

ONOOLEKA EKIBI KYO N’OGENDA MU GGULU?

Ensonga eno esaanidde okusalibwawo nga tonnava wano. Mu linnya lya Katonda, nkubuuza, Kiki ky’olonda—Kristo n’obulokozi, oba ekibi ky’oyagala ennyo n’okuzikirira? Tewali kkubo lya wakati. Okulindirira oba okugaana okusalawo, mu butuufu, kwe kusalawo okw’enkalakkalira ku lw’omubi. Oyo ayimirira ng’alowooza oba anaaba mwesigwa oba nedda, aba yamaze okuva ku lunyiriri olugolokofu: oyo atamanyi oba ayagala okunaazibwako ekibi aba alaga nti alina omutima omugwagwa.

Bw’oba weegomba okuleka buli kkubo ebbi, Mukama waffe Yesu ajja kukusobozesa okukikola amangu ddala. Ekisa kye kyamaze okukyusa ebyo by’oyagala: mu butuufu, omutima gwo guzziddwa buggya. N’olwekyo, weesigame ku ye akuwe amaanyi okulwanyisa ebikemo nga bwe bijja, n’okutuukiriza ebiragiro bya Mukama buli lunaku. Mukama Yesu mukugu nnyo mu kufuula omulema okubuuka ng’empeewo, n’okusobozesa abo abakoozimbye okusitula ebitanda byabwe ne batambula. Ajja kukusobozesa okuwangula empisa embi. Ajja n’okugoba Setaani mu ggwe. Weewaawo, ne bwe wandibadde ne dayimooni musanvu, yandizigobyemu amangu ago; amaanyi ge ag’okunaaza n’okutukuza tegalina kkomo. Kaakano nga oyagala okuwonyezebwa, obuzibu obusinga obunene buggiddwawo. Oyo atereezezza okwagala kwo asobola okulongoosa amaanyi go gonna amalala, n’agafuula okukola olw’ettendo lye. Tewandyegombye nnyo okuleka ekibi kyonna singa teyakukyusizza mu kyama okudda mu kkubo eryo. Bw’onoomwesiga kaakano, kinaaba kyeyoleka nti atandise omulimu omulungi mu ggwe, era tuli bakakafu nti ajja kugugenderako mu maaso.

fields.title: Ku Kubuuza Ebibuuzo.
fields.body_html:
Mu nnaku zino, okukkiriza okwangu okw’omwana omuto kwa kubula nnyo; wabula ekya bulijjo kwe kutakkiriza kintu na kimu, n’okubuusabuusa buli kintu. Okubuusabuusa kungi nnyo ng’obubala bw’omu nsiko, era emikono gyonna n’emimwa gyonna bisiigiddwako langi yaabwo. Nze kinneewuunyisa nnyo abantu okunoonya ebizibu ku bikwata ku bulokozi bwabwe bo bennyini. Singa nnali nsaliddwa okufa, ne mpulira akabonero k’okusaasirwa, ndi mukakafu nti saanditadde magezi gange ku kunoonya nsonga lwaki sisaanye kusonyiyibwa. Ekyo nandikirekedde abalabe bange: nze nandibadde ntunuulira ludda lwa njawulo ddala. Singa nnali mbbira, nandisoose kukwata ku kasubi okusinga okusindika ekyuma ekiwonya obulamu kive we ndi. Okuwakanya obulamu bwo ggwe kennyini kiba ng’okwetta mu ngeri ey’ekyama, omutamiivu yekka gw’ayinza okukola. Okuwakanya essuubi lyo lyokka kiba ng’omusirusiru atudde ku ttabi, n’alitemako alyoke agwe wansi. Ani okuggyako omusiru yandikoze ekyo? Kyokka bangi balabika ng’abawolereza ab’enjawulo ab’okuzikirira kwabwe. Banoonya mu Bayibuli yonna ebyawandiikibwa ebitiisatiisa; era bwe bamala ekyo, ne badda mu kulowooza kwabwe, ne mu bufirosoofo, ne mu kubuusabuusa, balyoke beggalire oluggi mu maaso gaabwe. Ddala guno mulimu mubi eri omuntu ow’amagezi.

Bangi mu biseera bino abatasobola kwewala ddala birowoozo bya ddiini, basobola okwewala okunyigirizibwa kw’omwoyo gwabwe okubateganya nga bakaayana ku mazima amakulu ag’okubikkulirwa. Ebyama ebinene byetaagisa okubeera mu Kitabo kya Katonda; kubanga Katonda atalina kkomo ayinza atya okwogera mu ngeri omuntu alina ekkomo n’ategeera ebirowoozo bye byonna? Naye bwe busirusiru obusingirayo ddala okutandika okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bintu bino ebizibu, n’oleka ku bbali amazima amangu agalokola emmeeme. Kijjukiza abafirosoofo babiri abaakubaganya ebirowoozo ku mmere, ne bava ku mmeeza nga bakyalumwa enjala, so ng’omukyalo owa bulijjo eyali mu nsonda teyabuuza kibuuzo na kimu, wabula yakozesa akambe ke n’ewuuma ye n’obunyiikivu bungi, n’agenda ng’asanyuka. Enkumi n’enkumi kaakano basanyufu mu Mukama olw’okukkiriza enjiri ng’abaana abato; so ng’abalala, bulijjo abalaba ebizibu, oba ababiyiiya, bakyali wala nga bwe baali okuva ku ssuubi lyonna eribudaabuda ery’obulokozi. Mmanyi abantu bangi ab’empisa ennungi abalabika ng’abaamalirira obutajja eri Kristo okutuusa nga bategedde engeri enjigiriza y’okulondebwa gy’ekwataganamu n’okuyita kw’enjiri okw’obwereere. Nange nandiyinzizza okumalirira obutalya ku kamu ku mugaati okutuusa lwe bandinnyinnyonnyodde engeri Katonda gy’ankuumamu nga ndi mulamu, so nga ate nteekwa okulya ndyoke mbeere mulamu. Amazima gali nti ffe abasinga obungi tumanyi ebimala dda, era kye twetaaga ddala si kitangaala mu mutwe, wabula mazima mu mutima; si buyambi okuyita mu bizibu, wabula kisa ekituleetera okukyawa ekibi n’okunoonya okutabaganyizibwa.

Wano ka nyongereko okulabula ku kunyoolanyoola Ekigambo kya Katonda. Tewali mpisa eyinza kusinga eno okuzikiriza emmeeme. Kuba kuyisaamu maaso okw’ekitiibwa ekitono okutuula wansi n’otereeza Omutonzi wo, era kuleetera omutima okukakanyala okusinga olubengo olwa wansi. Tujjukira omuntu omu eyakozesa akambe akatono ku Bayibuli ye, era tekyaluddewo n’aba nga alese byonna bye yali akkiriza edda. Omwoyo ogw’okussaamu ekitiibwa mulamu bulungi, naye okuyisaamu amaaso okuvumirira Ekigambo ekyaluŋŋamizibwa kuzikiriza enneewulira yonna entuufu eri Katonda.

Omuntu bw’atuuka okuwulira nti yeetaaga Omulokozi oluvannyuma lw’okuyisa Ekyawandiikibwa n’omwoyo ogw’amalala ogw’okuvumirira, kyangu nnyo okusanga omwoyo gwe nga gumuziyiza, ne gumulemesa okubudaabudibwa nga gumujjukiza engeri gye yayisaamu obubi Ekigambo ekitukuvu. Kimukaluubirira okufuna okubudaabudibwa mu bitundu bya Bayibuli bye yayisa ng’ebitaliiko makulu, oba n’abiteeka ku bbali ddala, ng’ebitasaanidde kulowoozebwako. Mu nnaku ye, ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu birabika ng’ebisekerera akabi ke. Ekiseera eky’obwetaavu bwe kituuka, enzizi ze yaziba n’amayinja tezimuwa mazzi ga kumalawo nnyonta ye. Weegendereze, bw’onyooma Ekyawandiikibwa, oleme okusuula mukwano gwo yekka ayinza okukuyamba mu ssaawa ey’obulumi.

Omwami omu ow’ekitiibwa ow’omu Bugirimaani yalina empisa ey’okuyita omuweereza we amusomere essuula ya Bayibuli buli nkya. Ekintu bwe kyabanga tekikwatagana na ndowooza ye, yaleekaananga n’obukambwe nti, "Hans, ekyo kisazeeko." Ku nkomerero Hans yamala ekiseera kiwanvu nga tannatandika kusoma. Yeetaaya mu Kitabo, okutuusa mukama we lwe yamukoowoola nti, "Hans, lwaki tosoma?" Awo Hans n’addamu nti, "Ssebo, kumpi tewakyali kisigaddeyo. Byonna bisaziddwako!" Olunaku olumu ebyo mukama we bye yawakanya byadda ku ludda olumu, n’olunaku olulala ne bidda ku ludda olulala, ebitundu ebirala ne bisangulibwa, okutuusa nga tewakyali kisigadde kumuyigiriza oba kumubudaabuda. Tuleme, olw’okunenya okw’okunoonya ensobi, okuzikiriza emikisa gyaffe ffe bennyini. Tuyinza okwetaaga ebisuubizo ebyo ebirabika ng’ebitali bya mugaso; era ebitundu ebyo eby’Ekyawandiikibwa Ekitukuvu abaakubuusabuusa bye basinze okulumba biyinza okuzuulibwa nga byetaagisa nnyo eri obulamu bwaffe bwennyini: kale, ka tukuume eky’obugagga kino ekitalina muwendo ekya Bayibuli, era tumalirire obutalekaayo na lunyiriri lumu lwayo.

Kiki kye tulina okukola n’ebibuuzo ebikwekeddwa ennyo ng’emmeeme zaffe ziri mu kabi? Ekkubo ery’okudduka ekibi ddangu ddala. Omutambuze, ne bw’aba musirusiru, talikubuliramu. Katonda tatuduulidde na bulokozi bwe tutayinza kutegeera. Kkiriza obeere mulamu kiragiro omwana omuwere ky’ayinza okutegeera n’okugondera.

Tobuusabuusa nate, kkiriza kaakano; Tobuuza, wabula weeweere bwereere. Okubuusabuusa n’ebirowoozo eby’obukujjukujju Bikomererwe ne Yesu ku muti.

Mu kifo ky’okunenya Ekyawandiikibwa, omuntu akulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda ajja kunywerera ku Mukama Yesu amangu ago. Bw’alaba nti enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu ab’empisa ennungi era ab’amagezi aga bulijjo—era abantu ab’ekitiibwa ekisingirayo—beesiga Yesu ne byonna bye balina, naye ajja kukola kye kimu, n’alekera awo okulwawo ennyongera. Olwo aba atandise obulamu obusaanidde okubeerwamu, era ayinza okulekera awo okutya. Ayinza amangu ago okweyongerayo mu ngeri y’obulamu esinga obugulumivu n’obulungi, ekula okuva mu kwagala Yesu, Omulokozi. Lwaki omusomi naye takikola amangu ago? Singa akikola!

Omusala w’ennyama mu Newark, New Jersey, yafuna ebbaluwa okuva ewaabwe ow’edda mu Bugirimaani, ng’emutegeeza nti, olw’okufa kw’omu ku b’enganda ze, asikidde ensimbi nnyingi. Mu kiseera ekyo yali asala embizzi. Bwe yamala okusoma ebbaluwa, n’akwakkula mangu ekiwero kye ekikyafu ekyali kimwambadde, era teyalinda kulaba nnyama ya mbizzi ng’esalibwamu soseegi, wabula n’ava mu dduuka n’agenda okweteekateeka okuddayo ewaabwe mu Bugirimaani. Omunenya, oba wandyagadde asigale mu Newark n’omuti gwe ogusalirwako n’embazzi ye ey’ennyama?

Laba wano okukkiriza bwe kukola. Omusala w’ennyama yakkiriza ekyo kye baamugamba, n’akikolerako amangu ago. Era yali musajja wa magezi!

Katonda yaweereza obubaka bwe eri omuntu, ng’amubuulira amawulire amalungi ag’obulokozi. Omuntu bw’akkiriza nti amawulire amalungi ga mazima, akkiriza omukisa ogumulangiriddwa, n’ayanguwa okugwekwatako. Bw’aba akkiriza mu mazima, ajja kutwala Kristo amangu ago, n’ebyo byonna by’alina okugaba, akyuke okuva mu makubo ge amabi ag’omu kiseera kino, asitule olugendo olw’okugenda mu Kibuga eky’omu Ggulu, omukisa omujjuvu gye gugenda okunyumirwa. Tayinza kuba mutukuvu mangu nnyo, wadde okuleka amakubo g’ekibi nga bukyali nnyo. Omuntu singa yali asobola okulaba ddala ekibi kye kiri, yandikidduse ng’adduka omusota ogutta, era yandisanyuse Kristo Yesu okumusumulula okuva mu kyo.

fields.title: Awatali Kukkiriza Tewali Bulokozi.
fields.body_html:
Abamu balowooza nti kikakali obutaba na kirala kibalindiridde wabula okuzikirira bwe bagaana okukkiriza Yesu Kristo; naye bw’onoolowooza okumala akaseera katono, ojja kulaba nti kya bwenkanya era kya magezi. Ndowooza tewali ngeri omuntu gy’ayinza kukuumamu maanyi ge okuggyako ng’alya. Singa wandigambye nti, "Sijja kuddamu kulya, nnyooma empisa eyo ey’ensolo," wandiyinzizza okugenda e Madeira, oba okutambula mu nsi zonna (singa wandiwangadde ekimala!), naye ddala wandizudde nti tewali mbeera ya bbanga wadde dduyiro eyandisobodde okukukuuma ng’oli mulamu singa wagaana emmere. Olwo wandyemulugunyizza nti, "Kikakali nze okufa kubanga sikkiriza mu kulya"? Si kintu kitali kya bwenkanya nti bw’oba omusirusiru n’otalya, oteekwa okufa. Bwe kiri ddala bwe kityo ne ku kukkiriza. "Kkiriza, onoolokolebwa." Bw’ogaana okukkiriza, si kikakali okubula. Kyandibadde kyewuunyisa ddala singa tekyali bwe kityo.

Omuntu alumwa ennyonta ayimiridde mu maaso g’ensulo. "Nedda," bw’agamba, "sirikwata ku ttondo lya mazzi na limu nga nkyali mulamu. Siyinza kumalawo nnyonta yange mu ngeri yange?" Tumugamba nti, nedda; ateekwa okunywa oba okufa. Agamba nti, "Sirinywa n’akatono; naye kikakali nti n’olwekyo nteekwa okufa. Kya bukakanyavu era kya bukambwe okuŋŋamba bwe kityo." Akyamye. Ennyonta ye kye kiva mu kulagajjalira etteeka ly’obutonde ekitayinza kwewalika. Naawe oteekwa okukkiriza oba okufa; lwaki ogaana okugondera ekiragiro? Nywa, ggwe omuntu, nywa! Twala Kristo obeere mulamu. Eryo lye kkubo ly’obulokozi, era okuliyingiramu oteekwa okwesiga Kristo; naye tewali kikakali mu kuba nti oteekwa okuzikirira bw’otoneesiga Mulokozi. Oboolyawo obeera ku ludda lw’omugga olulala, era olina okusala olutindo nga tonnatuuka waka. Obadde musirusiru nnyo n’olabirira endowooza nti tokkiriza mu ntindo, wadde mu maato, wadde nti waliwo ekintu ekiyitibwa amazzi. Ogamba nti, "Sijja kusomoka ku ntindo zammwe zonna, era sijja kulinnya mu maato gammwe gonna. Sikkiriza nti waliwo omugga, oba nti waliwo ekintu ng’amazzi." Oddayo ewaka, era mangu otuuka ku lutindo olw’edda; naye togenda kulusomokerako. Eryo eryato liri eri; naye omaliridde obutalirinnyamu. Ddala waliwo ekintu ekyonoonye amagezi go ag’okulowooza, kubanga tewandirowoozezza nti kikakali bwe kityo singa wali mu magezi go. Omuntu bw’agaana okukola ekyo ekyetaagisa okutuuka ku kigendererwa ekimu, ayinza atya okusuubira okukituukako? Onywedde obutwa, omusawo n’akuleetera eddagala erigoba obutwa, n’agamba nti, "Linywe mangu, oba ojja kufa; naye bw’onoolinywa mangu, nkukakasa nti obutwa bujja kuggwaamu amaanyi." Kale, ssebo, ojja kufa; era bwe banaakola okunoonyereza ku mulambo gwo ku nsonga y’okufa kwo, ensala ejja kuba nti, 'Kimusaanidde!' Bwe kityo bwe kinaaba ne ku ggwe bw’oneegamba, ng’omaze okuwulira enjiri ya Yesu Kristo, nti, "Ndi muntu eyakulaakulana ennyo okubaako kye nkola n’endowooza eyo ey’edda ey’omuntu okudda mu kifo ky’omulala. Olwo, bw’onoozikirira, ensala omuntu wo ow’omunda gy’alisala, oyo alituula ku kunoonyereza kwa Kabaka ku nkomerero, eriba bweti nti, "Okwetta: yazikiriza emmeeme ye ye." Bw’atyo bw’ayogera Ekitabo eky’edda—"Ggwe Isirayiri, weezikirizza wekka!" Omusomi, nkwegayiridde, tokola bw’otyo.

fields.title: Eri Abo Abakkirizza.
fields.body_html:
Mikwano gyange, obanga kaakano otandise okwesiga Mukama, mwesige mu bujjuvu, nga tolina ky’okuuma. Okukkiriza kwo kubeere ekintu ekisinga obutuufu n’okukola mu bulamu bwo bwonna. Teweesiga Mukama mu kuwulira obuwulizi ku bintu bitono eby’omwoyo ebinene; wabula mwesige mu buli kintu, emirembe gyonna, mu bulamu buno ne mu bulamu obutaggwaawo, ku lw’omubiri ne ku lw’emmeeme. Laba nga Mukama awanika ensi awatali kigiwanirira, wabula ekigambo kye kyokka! Terina kikondo wadde empagi. Ekitikkiro kino ekinene eky’eggulu kiyimiridde nga tekiriiko kikiwagira wadde omuti ogukiwanirira wakati. Mukama asobola, era ajja kwetikka, buli buzito okukkiriza bwe kuyinza okumussaako. Ebizibu ebisinga obunene byangu eri amaanyi ge, n’ebyama ebisinga okuzibuwala bitangaavu eri amagezi ge. Weesige Katonda okutuuka ku nkomerero. Weesigame, era weesigame nnyo; weewaawo, weesigame n’obuzito bwo bwonna, n’obuzito obulala bwonna, ku Katonda Ayinzabyonna owa Yakobo.

Ebiseera eby’omu maaso osobola okubirekera Mukama nga toyina kye weeraliikirira, oyo abeera mulamu ennaku zonna era atakyuka. Ebyayita kaakano biri mu mukono gw’Omulokozi wo, era tolisalirwa musango ku lwabyo, ne bwe byandibadde bitya, kubanga Mukama asudde ebyonoono byo mu buziba bw’ennyanja. Kkiriza mu kaseera kano ebirabo by’olina kaakano. Olokoleddwa. Obanga okkiriza Mukama Yesu, ggwe oli oyo avudde mu kuzikirira ng’atuuse mu bulamu, era OLOKOLEDDWA. Mu biseera eby’edda eby’obuddu, omukyala omu yaleeta omuweereza we omuddugavu ku lyato lya Bungereza, n’agamba Kapiteeni ng’aseka nti, "Ndowooza nti nze ne Senga Chloe singa tugenda e Bungereza, ye yandibadde wa ddembe?" Kapiteeni n’addamu nti, "Nnyabo, ali wa ddembe kaakano. Mu kaseera ke yalinnya ku lyato lya Bungereza yafuuka wa ddembe." Omukazi oyo omuddugavu bwe yategeera ekyo, teyava ku lyato — nedda n’akatono. Si kusuubira ddembe kwe kwamuwa obuvumu, wabula okuba nti eddembe yali alina. Bw’otyo naawe kaakano tosuubira busuubizi obulamu obutaggwaawo, wabula "Oyo akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo." Kino kikkirize ng’ekituufu ekyabikkulirwa mu Kigambo ekitukuvu, era otandike okusanyuka ng’okwo bwe kuli. Tokiwakanyaako mu birowoozo, wadde okukibuusabuusa; kikkirize, era obuuke olw’essanyu.

Njagala omusomi wange, bw’akkiriza Mukama Yesu, akkirize olw’obulokozi obutaggwaawo. Tomatira ndowooza nti oyinza okufuna okuzaalibwa okuggya okulizikira, obulamu obw’omu ggulu obuliggwaawo, okusonyiyibwa okulisazibwamu. Mukama Yesu awa endiga ze obulamu obutaggwaawo, era towummula okutuusa ng’obufunye. Kale, obanga bwa lubeerera, buyinza butya okuzikira? Lokolebwa mu bujjuvu, emirembe gyonna. Waliwo "ensigo ennamu etayinza kuvunda, ebeerawo era ey’olubeerera"; tokkiriza kulimbibwa na nkyukakyuka ya kaseera buseera, ekisa ekiringa ekimuli ekimulisa kyokka ne kiwotoka. Kaakano otandika olugendo ku ggaali y’omukka ey’ekisa — gula tikiti ekutuusa ku nkomerero y’olugendo. Saweebwa buyinza kubabuulira bulokozi bwa kiseera kitono: enjiri gye nalagirwa okubateeka mu maaso ye nti, "Abo bonna abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa." Alirokolebwa okuva mu kibi, okuva mu kuddayo mu kibi, okuva mu kukyamira mu kkubo eggazi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akukulembere okukkiriza ekyo, so si kitono ku ekyo. Omu agamba nti, "Otegeeza nti nkkirize nti bwe nnaaba nesize Kristo omulundi gumu, ndirokolebwa ne bwe nnaakola ekibi kyonna kye nnaayagala?" Ekyo sikyogeranga n’akatono. Obulokozi obw’amazima mbunnyonnyodde ng’enkyukakyuka ey’omutima ey’ekikulu ennyo, ekyusa bye wegomba ne by’oyagala; era ŋŋamba nti obanga enkyukakyuka ng’eyo ekoleddwa mu ggwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ejja kubeerera; kubanga omulimu gwa Mukama tegufaanana ng’omulimu ogw’ebbeeyi entono ogw’ennaku zino, ogwonooneka amangu. Weesige Mukama okukukuuma, ne bw’onoowangaala emyaka emeka, era ne bw’onookemebwa ennyo kyenkana wa; era "olw’okukkiriza kwammwe, kye musabye mukiweereddwa." Kkiriza Yesu olw’obulamu obutaggwaawo.

Woowe, singa era weesiga Mukama mu kubonaabona kwonna okw’omu biro bino! Mu nsi muno mujja kubonaabona; yiga mu kukkiriza okumanya nti ebintu byonna bikolera wamu olw’obulungi, olwo weewaayo mu by’ayagala Mukama. Laba endiga nga bagisala ebyoya. Bw’egalamira nga tekyukakyuka, makansi tegigikola bulabe; naye bw’erwanagana, oba bw’eddirira bweddirizi, eyinza okufumitibwa. Kale mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda, n’okubonaabona kujja kuggwaamu obwogi bwakwo. Okweyagaliza n’okwemulugunya bituleetera ennaku ezisinga emirundi kikumi ku eziva mu kubonaabona kwennyini. Kale kkiriza Mukama wo okutuuka ku kumanya ddala nti by’ayagala bisinga nnyo ebibyo, n’olwekyo tobigondera bugondezi, wabula n’obisanyukiramu.

Weesige Mukama Yesu ku nsonga ey’okutukuzibwa. Abantu abamu balabika ng’abalowooza nti Mukama Yesu tayinza kubatukuza ddala, omwoyo, emmeeme n’omubiri. N’olwekyo bawaayo eri ebibi ebimu na bimu nga beeyagalidde, nga balowooza nti tewali buyambi, wabula nti bateekwa okuwanga Setaani omusolo mu ngeri eyo okumala obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Tofukamiriza nsingo yo mu buswavu wansi w’obuddu bw’ekibi kyonna, wabula lwana nnyo olw’eddembe. Kabeere obusungu, oba obutakkiriza, oba obunafu, oba engeri endala yonna ey’obutali butuukirivu, tusobola, olw’ekisa kya Katonda, okugoba Omukanani, era n’okusingawo, tuteekwa okumugoba. Tewali mpisa nnungi etasoboka eri oyo akkiriza Yesu, era tewali kibi kirina kumuwangula. Ddala kyawandiikibwa nti, "Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga, kubanga temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda." Kkiriza olw’essanyu eringi mu Mukama, n’okufaanana Yesu, era weeyongere mu maaso okwefunira ddala ebintu bino eby’omuwendo; kubanga Nga bw’okkirizza kikukolerwe. "Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza"; era oyo asinga aboonoonyi bonna ayinza okutuuka obutabaako na katono k’asinzibwa abatukuvu abasinga obukulu.

Lowoozanga emirundi mingi ku ssanyu ery’omu ggulu. Kuno kukkiriza kwa kitiibwa; naye si kusinga kwe tusaanidde okuba nakwo. Mu kiseera kitono ennyo, omuntu akkiriza Mukama Yesu ajja kubeera naye gy’ali. Omutwe guno gulitikkirwa engule; amaaso gano galiraba kabaka mu bulungi bwe; amatu gano galiwulira eddoboozi lye ery’omuwendo; emmeeme eno eriba mu kitiibwa; n’omubiri guno omunafu guliyimusibwa okuva mu bafu ne gugattibwa n’emmeeme etuukiridde mu butavunda! Ekitiibwa, ekitiibwa, ekitiibwa! Era nga kiri kumpi nnyo, nga kikakafu nnyo. Ka tutandikirewo okwegezaamu ennyimba, era tutandike okuwoomerwa essanyu eryo nga terinnatuuka!

Naye omu akaaba nti, "Tetunnatuuka eyo." Nedda: naye okukkiriza kutujjuza essanyu olw’ebyo eby’omukisa ebitulindiridde, era nga bwe tukyali mu kkubo, kutuwanirira. Omusomi, njagala nnyo obeere omukkiriza omunywevu mu Mukama yekka. Njagala olinnye ddala ku lwazi, nga tolekayo kigere kimu ku musenyu. Mu bulamu buno obufa weesige Katonda mu bintu byonna; era mwesige yekka. Eno ye ngeri y’okubeera omulamu. Kino nkimanyi mu bye nnayitamu. Omukono gwa Katonda gwokka gumala ddala okwesigamako. Ka nkubuulireko katono ku bye yayitamu omusajja omu omukadde omupakasi gwe nnamanya edda. Yali atya Katonda okusinga bangi, era Omwoyo yali amuyigirizza nnyo mu bya buziba. Ekifaananyi kyange kijja kukulaga omuntu ki gwe yali — omukugu mu kusalira ensalosalo n’okusima emyala; naye omukugu okusingawo mu kwesiga okw’obwangu. Bw’ati bwe yannyonnyola okukkiriza:—"Gwali mwaka ogw’obutiti obw’amaanyi, nga sirina mulimu, era nga tewali mmere mu nnyumba. Abaana baali bakaaba. Omuzira gwali muwanvu, n’ekkubo lyange nga lya kizikiza. Mukozesa wange owedda yali aŋŋambye nti nsobola okufuna ku nku buli lwe nnandizeetaaze; kale ne ndowooza nti akaliro katono kandibugumizza abaana abo abaavu, ne ngenda n’ejjambiya yange okunoonya enku. Mu bufunze, okukkiriza okusinga obulungi kwe kukkiriza okwa buli lunaku: okukkiriza okukola ku mmere n’amazzi, amakooti n’amasogisi, abaana n’ente, ssente z’ennyumba n’obudde. Kiringa omuweereza akola buli mulimu, era kiri waka mu buli kika kya mulimu, ne mu buli ddaala ly’obulamu. Kya kisa kya buli lunaku, omwaka gwonna. Obwesige obutukuvu mu Katonda tebubulwa mulimu. Omusomi, ggwe nange tujja kuba n’endowooza emu mu kino: tetujja kwegomba kuba bakulu, wabula tujja kwagala nnyo okuba abalungi. Tujja kusaba Katonda waffe ku bikwata ku mirimu gyaffe egya buli lunaku nga bwe tumusaba ku bulokozi bw’emmeeme zaffe. Teweesiga Mukama mu kuwulira obuwulizi ku bintu bitono eby’omwoyo ebinene; wabula mwesige mu buli kintu, emirembe gyonna, mu bulamu buno ne mu bulamu obutaggwaawo, ku lw’omubiri ne ku lw’emmeeme. Laba nga Mukama awanika ensi awatali kigiwanirira, wabula ekigambo kye kyokka! Terina kikondo wadde empagi. Ekitikkiro kino ekinene eky’eggulu kiyimiridde nga tekiriiko kikiwagira wadde omuti ogukiwanirira wakati. Mukama asobola, era ajja kwetikka, buli buzito okukkiriza bwe kuyinza okumussaako. Ebizibu ebisinga obunene byangu eri amaanyi ge, n’ebyama ebisinga okuzibuwala bitangaavu eri amagezi ge. Weesige Katonda okutuuka ku nkomerero. Weesigame, era weesigame nnyo; weewaawo, weesigame n’obuzito bwo bwonna, n’obuzito obulala bwonna, ku Katonda Ayinzabyonna owa Yakobo. Ebiseera eby’omu maaso osobola okubirekera Mukama nga toyina kye weeraliikirira, oyo abeera mulamu ennaku zonna era atakyuka. Ebyayita kaakano biri mu mukono gw’Omulokozi wo, era tolisalirwa musango ku lwabyo, ne bwe byandibadde bitya, kubanga Mukama asudde ebyonoono byo mu buziba bw’ennyanja. Kkiriza mu kaseera kano ebirabo by’olina kaakano. Olokoleddwa. Obanga okkiriza Mukama Yesu, ggwe oli oyo avudde mu kuzikirira ng’atuuse mu bulamu, era OLOKOLEDDWA. Mu biseera eby’edda eby’obuddu, omukyala omu yaleeta omuweereza we omuddugavu ku lyato lya Bungereza, n’agamba Kapiteeni ng’aseka nti, "Ndowooza nti nze ne Senga Chloe singa tugenda e Bungereza, ye yandibadde wa ddembe?" Kapiteeni n’addamu nti, "Nnyabo, ali wa ddembe kaakano. Mu kaseera ke yalinnya ku lyato lya Bungereza yafuuka wa ddembe." Omukazi oyo omuddugavu bwe yategeera ekyo, teyava ku lyato — nedda n’akatono. Si kusuubira ddembe kwe kwamuwa obuvumu, wabula okuba nti eddembe yali alina. Bw’otyo naawe kaakano tosuubira busuubizi obulamu obutaggwaawo, wabula "Oyo akkiriza Omwana alina obulamu obutaggwaawo." Kino kikkirize ng’ekituufu ekyabikkulirwa mu Kigambo ekitukuvu, era otandike okusanyuka ng’okwo bwe kuli. Tokiwakanyaako mu birowoozo, wadde okukibuusabuusa; kikkirize, era obuuke olw’essanyu. Njagala omusomi wange, bw’akkiriza Mukama Yesu, akkirize olw’obulokozi obutaggwaawo. Tomatira ndowooza nti oyinza okufuna okuzaalibwa okuggya okulizikira, obulamu obw’omu ggulu obuliggwaawo, okusonyiyibwa okulisazibwamu. Mukama Yesu awa endiga ze obulamu obutaggwaawo, era towummula okutuusa ng’obufunye. Kale, obanga bwa lubeerera, buyinza butya okuzikira? Lokolebwa mu bujjuvu, emirembe gyonna. Waliwo "ensigo ennamu etayinza kuvunda, ebeerawo era ey’olubeerera"; tokkiriza kulimbibwa na nkyukakyuka ya kaseera buseera, ekisa ekiringa ekimuli ekimulisa kyokka ne kiwotoka. Kaakano otandika olugendo ku ggaali y’omukka ey’ekisa — gula tikiti ekutuusa ku nkomerero y’olugendo. Saweebwa buyinza kubabuulira bulokozi bwa kiseera kitono: enjiri gye nalagirwa okubateeka mu maaso ye nti, "Abo bonna abakkiriza ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa." Omu agamba nti, "Otegeeza nti nkkirize nti bwe nnaaba nesize Kristo omulundi gumu, ndirokolebwa ne bwe nnaakola ekibi kyonna kye nnaayagala?" Ekyo sikyogeranga n’akatono.
